summary: Kredivo, a leading digital consumer credit platform in Southeast Asia, and VPC Impact Acquisition Holdings II (VPCB), a SPAC sponsored by Victory Park Capital, have announced a definitive agreement for a business combination. This merger will result in FinAccel, Kredivo’s parent company, becoming publicly traded with an expected pro forma equity value of approximately $2.5 billion. The transaction is anticipated to deliver over $430 million in gross proceeds to the company, enabling Kredivo's continued growth in Indonesia, expansion into regional markets like Vietnam and Thailand, and entry into new business lines.

title: How Kabbage is helping American Express connect with small merchants
summary: American Express's acquisition of fintech Kabbage is strengthening its reach into the small business market, evidenced by the launch of Kabbage Checking and lines of credit. Kabbage's data technology enables faster lending decisions for small businesses, positioning Amex to compete with other payment providers and fintechs that offer integrated financial services. This strategy helps Amex diversify revenue beyond travel-related payments and assists overlooked small businesses in accessing crucial financial tools.

title: Walgreens launches myWalgreens credit card program
summary: Walgreens has launched the new myWalgreens Credit Card program, featuring two industry-first retail health and wellness credit cards issued by Synchrony Bank. These cards offer industry-leading rewards, including up to 10% Walgreens Cash rewards for healthy choices and purchases, and integrate seamlessly with the Walgreens app for a digital-led customer experience. The program aims to reward customers not just for what they buy, but for how they live, promoting healthier choices with no annual or membership fees.

title: Walgreens rolls out myWalgreens credit card program
summary: Walgreens has launched the myWalgreens Credit Card and myWalgreens Mastercard, in partnership with Synchrony Bank, as part of an expansion of its financial services. These cards offer various Walgreens Cash rewards for eligible in-store and out-of-store purchases, particularly focusing on health and wellness. The program aims to integrate with the myWalgreens loyalty platform and app, providing digital features for application and management.

title: Walgreens partners with Stamford-based Synchrony to launch credit card program
summary: Walgreens has announced a partnership with Stamford-based Synchrony Bank to launch a new credit card program. The program will include a myWalgreens Mastercard and a myWalgreens Credit Card, offering rewards at Walgreens stores and online. Synchrony will leverage its digital payment platform dApply and Quickscreen pre-approval engine to streamline the application process.

title: Walgreens launches myWalgreens credit card program, available in Puerto Rico
summary: Walgreens has introduced the new myWalgreens Credit Card program, in partnership with Synchrony Bank, offering two retail health and wellness credit cards. These cards, available in Puerto Rico, aim to reward personalized wellbeing choices with industry-leading rewards at Walgreens locations and other merchants. Cardholders can earn significant Walgreens Cash rewards for purchases, including a special bonus for their first transaction.

title: Payment Card Market SWOT Analysis by Key Players- MasterCard, Visa, Diner's Club
summary: This report from HTF MI provides a detailed SWOT analysis and forecast for the worldwide payment card market from 2021 to 2026. It covers market trends, growth drivers, technological advancements, and investment structures, segmenting the market by end-use, card types (contactless, contact, dual interface), and geographic regions. Key players analyzed include MasterCard, Visa, American Express, and others, offering insights into market share, value, and volume, along with critical factors influencing future growth.

title: HDFC Bank Allowed To Issue New Credit Cards after 8-Month Ban by RBI
summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has partially lifted its eight-month ban on HDFC Bank, allowing it to issue new credit cards again. The ban was imposed in December 2020 due to repeated technical glitches and outages in the bank's digital platforms. While HDFC Bank can now resume credit card issuance, restrictions on launching new digital products under its Digital 2.0 program will remain until further review by the central bank.

title: Mastercard is getting rid of its credit cards' magnetic stripes
summary: Mastercard is phasing out magnetic stripes on its credit and debit cards over the next decade, aiming for more secure alternatives. This move is driven by the rise of contactless payments, microchip technology, and biometric identification, which offer enhanced security compared to traditional magnetic stripes. Mastercard expects magnetic stripes to be completely eliminated by 2033, with chip-based cards becoming the new standard.

title: As Covid Lingers, Mastercard Revamps NYC Offices for a New Era
summary: Mastercard has renovated a 19th-century building in Manhattan's Flatiron District to accommodate a hybrid work model as the pandemic lingers. The new office space is designed to almost quadruple Mastercard's New York workforce to about 1,000 employees, focusing on engineers and technology workers. The design of meeting spaces was rethought to incorporate social distancing and support remote work needs.

title: Solana ETN
summary: The VanEck Solana ETN (VSOL) offers investors exposure to the Solana smart contract platform, a competitor to Ethereum, with 100% collateralization by SOL in cold storage at a regulated custodian. This ETN is tradeable on regulated stock exchanges and aims to provide a safe, cost-efficient, and easily integrated way to invest in Solana's high-speed and scalable blockchain technology. The article highlights Solana's fast transaction speeds, low costs, and proof-of-history consensus mechanism, along with an overview of its founder, Anatoly Yakovenko, and recent funding.

title: Walgreens launches health-linked credit card
summary: Walgreens has introduced a new myWalgreens Credit Card program, featuring two health and wellness-linked credit cards issued by Synchrony Bank. These Mastercard and credit cards are designed to reward personalized wellbeing choices, offering 10% Walgreens Cash rewards on Walgreens-branded products and 5% on other eligible brands and pharmacy purchases. The initiative aims to shift the focus from what customers buy to how they live, promoting healthy choices through its loyalty platform.

title: U.S. Bank partners with Mastercard on dual-network fleet card
summary: U.S. Bank is collaborating with Mastercard to launch a new dual-network fleet card called the U.S. Bank Voyager Mastercard. This new card combines the Voyager network with Mastercard's reach, allowing fleet operators to make fuel purchases and critical non-fuel emergency buys across a broader network, including Mexico and Canada, while maintaining spending controls. The partnership aims to increase convenience for drivers and capture more overall spend by expanding acceptance locations.

title: CIBC nabs Costco credit card partnership in Canada
summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) has secured a long-term agreement to become the issuer of credit cards at Costco stores in Canada, taking over from Capital One Financial. This deal, expected to start early next year, also includes CIBC acquiring over $3 billion in existing card balances from Capital One. The partnership reflects CIBC's strategy to expand its Canadian consumer banking business by attracting customers interested in everyday rewards, and comes after Costco made a similar issuer switch in the U.S. six years prior.

title: Scarlet™, a New Bank Account and Debit Mastercard®, Launches Exclusively at Walgreens, Promotes a Path to Financial Health, Earns Rewards on Purchases at Walgreens and Beyond
summary: Walgreens and InComm Payments have launched Scarlet, a new bank account and debit Mastercard, available exclusively at Walgreens. This service aims to simplify financial wellness by offering Walgreens Cash rewards, personal finance planning tools, and various payment solutions. Scarlet accountholders can earn rewards on purchases at Walgreens and other locations, benefit from features like early direct deposit and free ATM withdrawals, and use convenient banking solutions.

title: AmEx Deepens Its Ties in China Via an Acquiring Agreement With Leshua Technology
summary: American Express is strengthening its presence in China through an acquiring agreement with Leshua Technology. This partnership will enable Leshua to support acquiring for AmEx's joint venture, Express Technology Services Co. Ltd., which will begin processing transactions for AmEx-branded cards later this year. This move follows AmEx becoming the first foreign payments company to gain approval for clearing domestic transactions in mainland China, highlighting the continued efforts by U.S. payments networks to enter the massive Chinese market.

title: CIBC to acquire Costco co-brand credit card portfolio in Canada
summary: The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) has agreed to acquire Costco's co-brand credit card portfolio in Canada, holding over C$3bn in outstanding balances. Upon closing in early 2022, CIBC will become the exclusive issuer of Costco Mastercards in Canada, aiming to enhance rewards and grow its market share in payments. This partnership will also integrate the new CIBC Costco Mastercard with Costco's membership card, offering expanded benefits to members.

title: CIBC to purchase Costco credit card portfolio in Canada
summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) has announced its agreement to acquire the Canadian Costco credit card portfolio, which boasts over $3bn in outstanding balances. This acquisition includes a long-term agreement for CIBC to be the exclusive issuer of Costco Mastercards in Canada, replacing the current issuer, Capital One. The deal is expected to close in early 2022, after which CIBC will issue new co-branded Mastercards offering enhanced rewards and doubling as Costco membership cards.

title: Merricks v Mastercard: U.K. Competition Appeal Tribunal Gives Green Light for First Ever ‘Opt-out’ Class Action
summary: The UK's Competition Appeal Tribunal (CAT) has approved the first-ever "opt-out" Collective Proceeding Order (CPO) in the case of Merricks v Mastercard, allowing a claim for alleged overcharging of 46 million UK consumers to proceed. This landmark decision follows appeals up to the Supreme Court and establishes a significant precedent for future high-value competition law claims. While the CAT approved the overall CPO, it declined to include claims for deceased persons and compound interest due to specific legal and evidentiary requirements.

title: Santander presents LikeU, the first financial on demand cards that can also be used to contribute to a social cause
summary: Banco Santander Mexico has launched its new "LikeU" credit cards, offering customers personalized benefits, enhanced security features, and the ability to support social and environmental causes. These cards are 100% digital, allow payments from digital wallets, and come in six colors, each linked to a specific social cause like reforestation, child education, sea cleaning, or fighting breast cancer. Santander aims to commercialize one million LikeU cards in the first year, representing a 20% growth in its credit card portfolio.

title: NPCI and Fiserv launch RuPay credit card stack for fintechs and banks
summary: NPCI and Fiserv have partnered to launch nFiNi, a plug-and-play RuPay credit card stack designed for fintechs and banks. This banking-as-a-service program will significantly reduce onboarding time for issuing RuPay credit cards by providing a comprehensive suite of services, including card management, transaction processing, fraud management, and open APIs. The initiative aims to accelerate the penetration of RuPay cards and credit throughout India, particularly by enabling fintechs to reach new-to-credit customers.

title: Capital One beta-tests BNPL option, marking turnabout
summary: Capital One, despite previously barring its customers from using credit cards for buy-now, pay-later (BNPL) debt due to perceived risks, is now beta-testing its own BNPL service with existing customers and select merchants. This move signifies a significant shift in stance, as BNPL services have gained considerable traction among millennial and Gen Z consumers, attracting major players like Square (with Afterpay), PayPal, Citi, and JPMorgan Chase. The bank's CEO, Richard Fairbank, acknowledged the growth of the sector, largely fueled by merchants' willingness to subsidize higher costs for increased sales volume, and indicated that Capital One's offering would not be tied to its private-label credit cards.

title: TomoCredit Raises $10 Million in Series A Funding to Help Build Credit for First Time Borrowers
summary: TomoCredit, a fintech company specializing in credit cards for first-time borrowers, announced a $10 million Series A funding round led by Kapor Capital and KB Investment Inc., bringing its total funding to $17 million this year. The company aims to address the credit access issues faced by 76% of GenZ and Millennials who lack a credit history. The funding will be used to enhance product features and expand hiring, enabling TomoCredit to provide a no-fee credit card with 0% APR to a broader audience, including immigrants and foreign students, by focusing on cash flow instead of traditional credit scores.

title: Here’s how Morehouse and Spelman will use $5M from Mastercard - Atlanta Business Chronicle
summary: Morehouse College and Spelman College in Atlanta are set to establish a Center for Black Entrepreneurship on their campuses. This initiative is made possible by a $5 million donation from Mastercard, with additional support from Bank of America. The center aims to develop the next generation of Black entrepreneurs.

title: Apple Pay: Usuarios logran enrolar tarjetas de crédito del Banco de Chile
summary: Clients of Banco de Chile successfully enrolled their credit cards with Apple Pay by changing their device's region to the United States. This unexpected integration suggests an imminent official launch of Apple Pay in Chile, despite the bank later blocking the enrollment possibility and declining to comment. The temporary success and subsequent notification indicate a direct, albeit unofficial, link between Banco de Chile and Apple's payment platform.

title: Barclays US Consumer Bank Announces Lili Tomovich As Chief Marketing Officer
summary: Barclays US Consumer Bank has announced the appointment of Lili Tomovich as its new Chief Marketing Officer, where she will oversee brand, customer experience, marketing technology, and research. Tomovich brings extensive marketing leadership experience from various industries including financial services, retail, entertainment, and hospitality. She will report to Denny Nealon, CEO of Barclays US Consumer Bank, and join the consumer bank's executive committee, with a focus on driving continued growth and diversification.

title: Payment industry racks up two more deals
summary: The payments industry is experiencing a significant acquisition spree, moving towards a potentially record-breaking year for deal volume, driven by fintech startups and the shift to digital payments accelerated by COVID-19. Key deals include SpotOn acquiring Appetize, and FortisPay purchasing OmniFund, demonstrating a trend of incumbents and well-funded startups buying rivals and new technologies. While the number of acquisitions is high, the total dollar value for these deals remains below previous records.

title: Bilt Rewards Raises $60 Million From Wells Fargo, Mastercard, And The Nation's Largest Real Estate Owners To Scale Its Loyalty Program And Credit Card For Renters
summary: Bilt Rewards announced a $60 million growth funding round from investors including Wells Fargo, Mastercard, and major real estate owners. This funding, less than 90 days after launch, values the company at $350 million and will scale its loyalty program and credit card for renters. Bilt Rewards also introduced new loyalty benefits, including a "0-1-2-3" points earning structure for its Mastercard, offering 1x on rent, 2x on travel, and 3x on dining with no annual fee.

title: Residential landlords back $60M investment in startup offering reward points on rent
summary: Bilt Rewards, a NoHo-based startup, has secured $60 million in funding from major investors including Blackstone, AvalonBay Communities, and Related, to expand its unique rental rewards business. The company offers credit-card style points for rent payments without processing fees, aiming to help renters build credit and save for a down payment. Bilt makes revenue through landlord commissions and non-rent credit card transactions, differentiating itself in the market by providing surcharge-free rent rewards and compelling transfer partners.

title: Argus Capital (ARGUU) Stock Price, News & Analysis
summary: Argus Capital (ARGUU) stock information indicates its operations currently lack significance, with the company aiming for a business combination in the media/entertainment/sports industries. It IPO'd on September 22nd, 2021, raising $265 million. The stock is marked as potentially delisted, and there is no market capitalization due to its pre-operational status.

title: OIP Robotics boosts automation portfolio with Hyperscience partnership
summary: Specialty lines insurtech firm OIP Robotics has partnered with automation start-up Hyperscience to enhance its data extraction capabilities, integrating Hyperscience’s intelligent document processing software. This collaboration aims to boost efficiency in insurance firms, reduce error rates, and expand automation in the excess and surplus (E&S) insurance market by allowing systems to learn from human input. The partnership is expected to radically improve organizational agility and accelerate digital transformation within the industry.

title: Sezzle payment solution review
summary: Sezzle is a payment solution that allows e-commerce and retail businesses to offer customers flexible payment options, such as splitting purchases into four interest-free payments over six weeks. Businesses benefit from Sezzle handling fraud, chargebacks, and repayments, while customers appreciate the financial flexibility. The platform integrates easily with major e-commerce platforms like Shopify and Magento, making it a valuable tool for boosting online sales.

title: News | This Months-Old Startup Attracts Major Landlord Investors From Blackstone to Starwood
summary: Bilt Rewards, a startup founded in June, has secured $60 million in growth funding from major landlords like Blackstone, AvalonBay Communities, and Starwood Capital Group. This investment supports Bilt Rewards' unique loyalty program, which allows apartment renters to earn points on rent payments without fees, redeemable for travel, fitness classes, home items, or even towards rent or a mortgage down payment. The platform aims to enhance tenant engagement and retention, and Bilt has also partnered with Mastercard to offer a credit card for earning reward points on rent.

title: Mastercard to Preview New Fragrances at Fashion Group International’s Night of Stars Celebration
summary: Mastercard is introducing two new fragrances, "Priceless passion" and "Priceless optimism," which will be previewed at Fashion Group International's Night of Stars celebration. These fragrances are part of Mastercard's evolving multisensory branding strategy, following its symbol-only brand mark, sonic brand, and taste-based initiatives. Crafted by female perfumers and incorporating sustainable ingredients, the fragrances embody Mastercard's commitment to inclusivity and sustainability.

title: Palestinians urge PayPal to offer services in West Bank and Gaza
summary: Palestinian digital rights group 7amleh and local entrepreneurs are urging PayPal to extend its services to the West Bank and Gaza, citing discriminatory practices and economic hindrances. They argue that PayPal's absence, despite its availability to Israeli bank account holders in the same region, disadvantages Palestinian businesses and freelancers who rely on e-commerce for income. The Palestine Monetary Authority (PMA) has hinted at potential progress on this issue in the near future.

title: Ally to return to credit cards with $750M deal to buy Fair Square Financial
summary: Ally Financial announced its return to the credit card business by acquiring Fair Square Financial for $750 million in an all-cash deal expected to close by Q1 2022. This acquisition follows Ally's previous exit from credit cards in 2019 and a failed $2.7 billion merger with CardWorks in 2020. Fair Square Financial, a digital-first credit card company focusing on below-prime consumers, will help Ally enhance its offerings and provide differentiated products to its growing customer base.

title: From pushback on Facebook's digital wallet to iris scanning for free coins: 6 things that happened in crypto this past week
summary: This article summarizes six key developments in the crypto space from the past week, including Bitcoin and Ether reaching new all-time highs. Other significant events include the launch of the first U.S. futures-based bitcoin ETF, senators' pushback against Facebook's Novi digital wallet project, Worldcoin's iris-scanning-for-crypto initiative, Robinhood's crypto wallet waitlist exceeding 1 million users, Mastercard's move to allow crypto services on its network, and Nigeria's central bank digital currency going live.

title: Three U.S. banks agree to $66 million ATM antitrust deal, class counsel says
summary: Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and JPMorgan Chase have agreed to a $66.7 million settlement in a consumer antitrust lawsuit. The settlement resolves claims that the banks conspired to fix ATM surcharges, with Bank of America paying $26.4 million, Wells Fargo $20.8 million, and JPMorgan Chase $19.5 million. The deal still requires preliminary court approval, while Visa and Mastercard, also named in the lawsuit, are contesting a class certification order.

title: Dual Interface Payment Card Market Size Report, 2022-2030
summary: The global dual interface payment card market reached USD 8,026.4 million in 2023 and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 16.7% from 2024 to 2030, driven by advancements in payment card chips, integration of NFC and RFID, and increasing demand for contactless payments. Key factors include consumer preference for fast and secure transactions, the COVID-19 pandemic's impact on contactless adoption, and rising demand in the banking sector for biometric-integrated cards. The market also faces challenges such as security concerns and the cost of hardware upgrades, with plastic and retail segments holding significant shares.

title: Amex rolls out first-ever debit card
summary: American Express has launched its first-ever debit card and checking account offering in the U.S., targeting small- and mid-sized businesses. This move marks a significant shift for Amex, which has primarily focused on credit cards, and comes as debit card usage has increased since the COVID-19 pandemic. The new account offers benefits like no minimum balance, 1.1% interest on balances up to $500,000, and no monthly fees.

title: PR News | On the Move: Whirlpool Ups Klyn to SVP-Comms. - Mon., Nov. 1, 2021
summary: Whirlpool Corporation has promoted Pamela Klyn to Senior Vice President, Communications, Public Affairs, and Sustainability, effective January 1, succeeding D. Jeffrey Noel. The article also details other significant personnel changes: Christine Elliott is named Managing Director – Global Head of Corporate Affairs at Moody’s Corporation, Julia Fuller joins Ford Hutman Media as Executive Vice President, and Casey Blatt becomes Senior Director of Operations at Crowe PR, which also promoted Kaitlin Egan to Director of Hospitality.

title: Introducing the Toast Restaurant Card, the First Business Debit Card Purpose-Built for Restaurants
summary: Toast has launched its new Toast Restaurant Card, a business debit Mastercard designed specifically for the restaurant industry. This card offers restaurateurs faster access to their credit card sales, often within an hour, and provides cashback rewards with select restaurant-specific merchants. Integrated into Toast's all-in-one platform, it aims to simplify financial management and address the challenges restaurants face with capital access, with no sign-up or monthly maintenance fees.

title: Amazon to stop accepting Visa's UK-issued credit cards over high fees
summary: Amazon announced it will stop accepting UK-issued Visa credit cards from January 19, 2022, citing high transaction fees charged by Visa. While Visa debit cards and other credit card types like Mastercard and Amex will still be accepted, Visa expressed disappointment and hopes for a resolution. This move comes after Brexit removed an EU-enforced cap on card issuer fees in the UK, leading to calls for government intervention in UK-EU trade agreements and scrutiny of credit card fees from regulators.

title: Amazon (AMZN) in Talks to Switch Co-Brand Card to Mastercard (MA) From Visa (V)
summary: Amazon.com Inc. is reportedly in discussions to switch its co-branded credit card from Visa Inc. to Mastercard Inc. This potential move comes amidst ongoing disputes over payment costs, highlighted by Amazon's decision to ban Visa cards in the U.K. next year. The company is using the renewal talks for its significant co-branded card portfolio to negotiate more favorable terms with Visa.

title: Credit crunch: Visa tumbles on Amazon ban in UK
summary: Visa Inc. experienced a significant decline after Amazon.com Inc. announced it would stop accepting Visa credit cards issued in the U.K., citing high transaction fees. Amazon is also reportedly considering switching its co-branded credit card to Mastercard, further impacting Visa's stock and contributing to a 20% drop from its July record high. This move is part of broader international changes Amazon has made regarding Visa cards and comes amidst waxing investor sentiment towards credit card stocks due to the rise of "buy now, pay later" services.

title: Visa takes complaint against RuPay India to US govt; wants action
summary: Visa has formally complained to the U.S. government that India's "informal and formal" promotion of its domestic payments rival RuPay is unfair and detrimental to its business in a key market. This complaint highlights concerns about a level playing field, especially given Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public endorsement of RuPay as a national service. Mastercard has also privately raised similar concerns regarding the Indian government's push for RuPay.

title: American Express taps Opy for its first US third-party BNPL offering
summary: American Express is partnering with Opy, the U.S. subsidiary of Openpay, for its first third-party Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) offering in the United States. This partnership will allow Amex cardmembers to use Opy's "buy now, pay smarter" solution for qualifying purchases in the healthcare and automotive sectors, offering longer repayment terms and higher loan amounts than traditional BNPL providers. The initiative aims to help Amex cater to demand for financing larger purchases over extended periods, complementing its existing "Pay it Plan it" program.

title: 8 Cheapest Ways To Send Money To The Philippines
summary: This article provides a guide on the cheapest ways to send money to the Philippines, primarily for Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in the US. It highlights the high cost of traditional bank transfers and explains how money transfer companies profit through exchange rate margins and fees. The article offers advice on comparing services, utilizing discounts, and understanding various payment and payout options to maximize the amount received by beneficiaries.

title: Caribou Coffee Data Breach Class Action Settlement
summary: Caribou Coffee has agreed to a nearly $6 million settlement to resolve claims that it mishandled a 2018 data breach affecting banks and credit unions. The breach, which occurred from August to December 2018, allegedly compromised payment card information from 473 locations and forced financial institutions to bear costs for cancelling cards and reimbursing fraudulent charges. The settlement provides cash payments to affected financial institutions and non-monetary injunctive relief for data security measures.

title: Avalanche ETN
summary: The VanEck Avalanche ETN (VAVA) offers investors exposure to the Avalanche smart contract platform, trading like an ETF and 100% collateralized with AVAX in cold storage. It highlights Avalanche's high velocity, low cost, eco-friendly nature, and cutting-edge validation mechanism. The article also details the platform's founder, Emin Gün Sirer, the value proposition of Avalanche's smart contracts, and the utility of its native token, AVAX, while outlining the benefits and risks of investing in the ETN.

title: Go With GINN as High-Margin Companies Remain Trendy
summary: Investors are expected to favor quality, high-margin companies in 2022, a trend supported by the Goldman Sachs Innovate Equity ETF (GINN). GINN tracks companies with robust profitability, strong earnings growth, and effective margin management, aligning with Goldman Sachs' recommendation for clients. Several of GINN's holdings, including Alphabet, Meta Platforms, Apple, Marvell Technology, Mastercard, PayPal, Autodesk, and Etsy, are featured on Goldman's list of high-margin companies.

title: KyckGlobal And ACI Team Up to Give Businesses More Options For Disbursements
summary: KyckGlobal Inc. is partnering with ACI Worldwide Inc. to expand disbursement options for businesses. This collaboration will allow businesses to make payments to consumers through various channels, both domestically and internationally, including PayPal, Venmo, ACH, prepaid cards, push-to-card payments, and cash. This initiative aims to simplify payments for both banked and unbanked consumers and is expected to particularly benefit industries like insurance.

title: McDonald's is selling digital tech startup Dynamic Yield to Mastercard
summary: McDonald's announced it is selling Dynamic Yield, a digital tech startup it acquired in 2019, to Mastercard for an undisclosed amount. Dynamic Yield specializes in personalization and decision logic technology, which McDonald's used to enhance its drive-thru experience. This sale will allow Dynamic Yield to expand its technology to other third-party businesses, while McDonald's will continue to collaborate with both companies to scale the technology in its locations.

title: McDonald’s to Sell Digital Startup Dynamic Yield to Mastercard
summary: McDonald’s announced its decision to sell Dynamic Yield, a digital startup it acquired nearly three years ago, to Mastercard Inc. McDonald's initially bought Dynamic Yield to enhance sales at drive-throughs and digital kiosks by providing personalized digital promotions, and the startup has been operating as a standalone company. This sale comes as McDonald's faces increasing competition in the fast-food market.

title: Can Visa Maintain Its Lead?
summary: Morningstar analyst Brett Horn suggests that while Visa faces near-term challenges, such as the impact of the coronavirus on cross-border transactions, its long-term growth prospects and market dominance remain strong due to the ongoing shift toward electronic payments. The company's scalable business model and "tollbooth" position in the global payment infrastructure are expected to help it maintain its wide economic moat and improve margins over time.

title: MoneyGram (MGI) Ties Up to Ease India's Cross-Border Remittances
summary: MoneyGram International (MGI) has partnered with Paytm Payments Bank to enable real-time cross-border remittances to Paytm Wallets in India, expanding its mobile wallet capabilities in a major inbound market for remittances. This collaboration aims to digitize the money movement process, aligning with MGI's focus on digital capabilities and capitalizing on the significant demand for faster remittances in India. The move follows similar digitalization efforts by other companies like Western Union, Visa, and Mastercard in the cross-border payments sector.

title: Synchrony Financial stock rises Monday, still underperforms market
summary: Synchrony Financial stock (SYF) saw a slight increase of 0.04% on Monday, closing at $46.18, even as the broader market, including the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average, experienced significant gains. Despite this rise, the stock underperformed compared to the general market and closed $6.31 below its 52-week high. Competitors such as Visa Inc. Cl A saw gains, while Mastercard Inc. and FleetCor Technologies Inc. experienced slight declines.

title: Payments firms see slam dunk opportunity with sports venues
summary: The sports and events industry is becoming a major focus for digital payments companies, which are introducing new technologies to enhance the fan experience and gather valuable data. The push for cashless and contactless transactions was accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to the adoption of mobile ordering, self-service kiosks, and checkout-free options in stadiums and arenas. These advancements not only speed up transactions but also provide venues with crucial insights into fan behavior and purchasing habits.

title: GM launches new credit card with Goldman Sachs
summary: General Motors has partnered with Goldman Sachs to launch a new credit card and revamped its rewards program. The "My GM Rewards" card, issued by Mastercard through Goldman Sachs, allows customers to earn points for buying or leasing GM vehicles. This initiative marks Goldman Sachs' second credit card offering through its Marcus consumer bank, further expanding its presence in mainstream lending.

title: CMPO
summary: This article provides a detailed financial overview of CompoSecure Inc. (CMPO), including its stock price, key financial metrics, recent news, and insider trading activity. It highlights the company's performance, analyst ratings, and strategic developments in its payment card and Arculus segments.

title: Ironclad Raises $150 Million Series E Funding, Led by Franklin Templeton
summary: Ironclad, a digital contracting platform, has secured $150 million in Series E funding, bringing its total investment to $333 million. The round was led by Franklin Templeton and included existing investors such as BOND, YC Continuity, and Sequoia Capital. Ironclad plans to use the capital to accelerate product innovation and expand its platform, which is utilized by companies like L'Oréal, Mastercard, and the Texas Rangers.

title: Global Payments looks to expand clients, services
summary: Global Payments, Inc. aims to expand its market in the Philippines by targeting more small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and introducing additional services such as QR payments. The company plans to grow its SME business by at least 15% this year and is exploring partnerships to join the QR Ph person-to-merchant (P2M) use case. This expansion aligns with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas' goal of transitioning to a cash-lite economy, with merchant payments making up a significant portion of retail transactions.

title: World’s first DeFi ETF to be listed on the Brazilian stock exchange in February
summary: Hashdex, the largest crypto asset manager in Latin America, announced that its DeFi exchange-traded fund (ETF) would be listed on the Brazilian stock exchange, B3, under the ticker DEFI11 on February 17th. This ETF, the first of its kind globally, will track the "CF DeFi Composite Index," covering 12 assets across major dApps, service protocols, scalability solutions, and Ethereum as a settlement network. Hashdex aims to provide investors with regulated exposure to the DeFi market and believes in DeFi's potential to significantly impact the financial sector.

title: Mastercard Unveils Next-Generation Virtual Card Solution for Instant B2B Payments
summary: Mastercard has launched Mastercard Track Instant Pay, a new virtual card solution that uses machine learning to authorize and initiate instant payment of supplier invoices. This solution integrates with Mastercard Track Business Payment Service, aiming to improve efficiency, speed, and choice for B2B payments by automating processes and enhancing cash flow for both buyers and suppliers.

title: Synchrony Financial stock outperforms competitors despite losses on the day
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) experienced a 1.64% loss on Friday, closing at $44.42, amidst a general market downturn. Despite this fifth consecutive day of losses, the stock outperformed several key competitors, including Visa Inc. Cl A, Mastercard Inc., and FleetCor Technologies Inc., which saw larger declines. Trading volume for Synchrony Financial exceeded its 50-day average.

title: JPMorgan buys 49% stake in Greek payments company
summary: JPMorgan Chase has acquired a 49% stake in the Greek fintech Viva Wallets as part of its ongoing acquisition strategy. The Athens-based company provides payment solutions to small and medium-sized businesses across 23 European countries. This investment, valued over $1.15 billion, will help Viva Wallets expand its localized payment services throughout Europe.

title: AmEx Downplays Crypto And BNPL As It Posts a Revenue Jump ‘Beyond Our Expectations’
summary: American Express Co. reported a significant revenue jump in the fourth quarter of 2021, driven by a strong recovery in its travel-and-entertainment business. Despite this success, CEO Stephen Squeri downplayed major forays into cryptocurrency and buy now, pay later (BNPL) lending, viewing crypto as too volatile for payments and BNPL as targeting a different audience than AmEx's core cardholders. The company's focus remains on its traditional travel and entertainment sectors, which are expected to fully recover by the end of the year.

title: SAP to Acquire Leading Working Capital Management Company Taulia
summary: SAP SE announced its intent to acquire a majority stake in Taulia, a leading provider of working capital management solutions. This acquisition aims to enhance companies' access to liquidity and improve cash flows by expanding SAP's Business Network and CFO solutions. Taulia will continue to operate as an independent company within the SAP Group, with SAP CFO Luka Mucic becoming Chairman of the Board.

title: Fiserv Acquiring Finxact for Digital Banking Acceleration
summary: Fiserv, a payments and financial services platform, has agreed to acquire cloud-native banking solution Finxact Inc. for approximately $650 million. This acquisition aims to accelerate the delivery of digital banking experiences for Fiserv's clients by integrating Finxact's API-first capabilities with Fiserv's existing digital financial solutions. The deal will enable Fiserv to provide a streamlined path for clients to offer advanced digital solutions to their customers.

title: Apple Just Quietly Introduced a Feature to Your iPhone That Is Going to Upend This $1.7 Trillion Industry
summary: Apple has introduced a new feature called "Tap to Pay on iPhone," allowing merchants to accept contactless payments directly on their iPhones without extra hardware. This move is set to disrupt the $1.7 trillion contactless payment industry, which has been dominated by services requiring separate terminals like Square. Stripe is announced as the first payment platform to integrate this new capability, making iPhones even more powerful tools for small businesses.

title: Mastercard Expands Consulting with Practices Dedicated to Crypto, Open Banking and ESG
summary: Mastercard is expanding its consulting services with new practices focused on Open Banking, Open Data, Crypto & Digital Currencies, and Environment, Social & Governance (ESG). This expansion aims to help businesses navigate evolving preferences, digital transformation, and geopolitical shifts. Mastercard's Data & Services, which already includes over 2,000 data scientists, engineers, and consultants, is growing its team to deliver an integrated approach through these new specialized groups.

title: BBVA: me aumentaron el límite después de cinco años ¿Falló el sistema?
summary: The author, a long-time BBVA customer, details a surprising increase in his credit card limit after five years of no changes, coinciding with the end of BBVA's alliance with Latam Pass. He speculates whether this is a system error or a desperate attempt by the bank to retain customers, as many others also report similar issues with limits not being updated for years. The article also touches on his decision to close his cards due to the end of the Latam Pass benefits and the bank's general poor service regarding credit limits.

title: Crypto exchanges won't bar Russians, raising fears of sanctions backdoor
summary: Major cryptocurrency exchanges are refusing to implement a blanket ban on Russian users, despite Western sanctions targeting Moscow and a plea from the Ukrainian government. They argue that a full ban goes against the libertarian ethos of cryptocurrency, though they will block accounts of individuals explicitly targeted by sanctions. This stance raises concerns among anti-money laundering specialists that crypto could serve as a loophole for Russians to circumvent financial isolation.

title: Fidelity National Information Services Inc. stock falls Thursday, underperforms market
summary: Fidelity National Information Services Inc. (FIS) stock declined by 2.71% on Thursday, closing at $92.67. This performance underperformed the broader market, as the S&P 500 Index fell 0.53% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 0.29%. The company's stock also lagged behind competitors like Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc., and Fiserv Inc.

title: Mastercard, Visa, PayPal, Amex Suspend Russian Operations
summary: American Express has joined Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal in suspending all operations in Russia in response to the country's invasion of Ukraine. This means that globally issued Amex cards will not work in Russia, and Russian-issued cards will not work outside the country on the Amex network. Mastercard and Visa also announced similar suspensions, ceasing support for cards issued by Russian banks and disabling card usage at Russian merchants and ATMs. PayPal had already suspended domestic services in Russia in 2020, and this latest action extends to its cross-border payment business.

title: After Visa & Mastercard, American Express suspends operations in Russia and Belarus
summary: American Express has announced the suspension of all operations in Russia and Belarus, following similar moves by Visa and Mastercard. This decision comes in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine. As a result, American Express cards issued globally will no longer function in Russia, and cards issued by Russian banks will not work outside the country on the American Express network.

title: JPMorgan joins Goldman Sachs in pulling back from Russia
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. are pulling back from Russia in response to the country’s invasion of Ukraine, joining other major companies in halting business operations. JPMorgan specifies its activities are limited to helping clients and managing risk, while Goldman Sachs plans to close operations and has minimal exposure to Russia. This move further isolates Russia economically as other financial and consumer companies also restrict their presence.

title: eBay To Launch its Own Digital Wallet and other Digital Transactions News briefs from 3/11/22
summary: eBay announced the launch of its own digital wallet to allow sellers to use sales proceeds for purchases or expenses. Western Union, Discover, and Cleverbridge have suspended operations in Russia and Belarus following the invasion of Ukraine. New data also shows an increase in Visa spending momentum and the growing adoption of Buy Now, Pay Later options.

title: Apple Pay has arrived in Argentina: how to pay with the iPhone and what are its advantages?
summary: Apple Pay is now available in Argentina, allowing iPhone and Apple Watch users to make contactless payments at merchants with NFC-enabled POS devices. The service works with Visa and Mastercard from several major banks like Patagonia, BBVA, Galicia, and ICBC, utilizing NFC technology for secure transactions. Apple emphasizes the security and privacy of Apple Pay, as it protects card numbers by assigning unique device account numbers and encrypting data, providing a safer alternative to physical cards and cash.

title: Apple Pay, disponible en Argentina: estos son los bancos y las tarjetas con los que funciona
summary: Apple Pay, the contactless payment system for iPhone and Apple Watch, has launched in Argentina and Peru. Several Argentine banks, including Galicia, BBVA, Brubank, ICBC, Macro, and Patagonia, along with Visa and Mastercard, support the service. Users can configure Apple Pay through the Wallet app and make secure, contactless payments using Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode.

title: Fewer taxpayers plan to pay the IRS by check
summary: A survey by payments firm ACI Worldwide reveals a declining trend in taxpayers opting to pay their annual income taxes by check, dropping from 21% last year to 18% this year. Gen Z, millennials, and Gen X are increasingly moving towards digital payment methods, which are considered more secure. While mobile payment usage has risen, alternative methods like PayPal or Venmo are still used by a small percentage, primarily younger generations.

title: Wells Fargo Partners with Bilt Rewards and Mastercard to Issue the First Credit Card that Earns Points on Rent payments without the Transaction Fee
summary: Wells Fargo, Bilt Rewards, and Mastercard have partnered to launch the Bilt Mastercard, the first co-brand credit card that allows renters to earn points on rent payments without transaction fees. This no-annual-fee card offers rewards for travel, dining, and other purchases, and uniquely enables renters to accumulate points towards a home down payment. The partnership aims to transform rent payments into a rewarding experience and expand access to this unique offering to millions of renters across the U.S.

title: Wells Fargo Brings Reward Points to Apartment Renters with Bilt
summary: Wells Fargo has partnered with Bilt Rewards to launch a co-branded Mastercard, allowing renters to earn reward points on rent payments without transaction fees. This new card offers 1x points on rent, 2x on travel, and 3x on dining, addressing a significant market gap by enabling rewards on the $500 billion spent annually on rent in the U.S. This move signifies Wells Fargo's renewed commitment to competitive offerings in the U.S. credit card business.

title: Bread Financial™ and Victoria’s Secret Launch New Co-Brand Mastercard®, Renew Long-Standing Partnership
summary: Bread Financial and Victoria's Secret have launched a new co-brand Mastercard program and renewed their long-standing private label credit card program. The new Mastercard offers enhanced rewards, including 5% back on Victoria's Secret and PINK purchases for eligible cardmembers, 2% back on bonus categories, and 1% on all other purchases, alongside an activation bonus. This partnership aims to provide modernized credit offerings with increased benefits and security for Victoria's Secret customers.

title: Amazon renews Prime credit card tie-up with JPMorgan Chase after flirting with American Express
summary: Amazon has renewed its agreement with JPMorgan Chase to issue its flagship Prime rewards credit card, following months of intense negotiations where other financial institutions like American Express and Synchrony also vied for the lucrative partnership. The deal maintains the card's rich 5% rewards rate for Amazon.com and Whole Foods purchases and highlights the significant value these co-brand credit card partnerships hold for issuing banks. This renewal continues a long-standing relationship between Amazon and JPMorgan, dating back to 2002.

title: Bread Financial Debuts Amex Cashback Credit Card
summary: Bread Financial has launched the Bread Cashback American Express Credit Card, offering consumers unlimited 2% cash back without annual fees, reward caps, or foreign transaction fees. This new card, a partnership with American Express, provides cardholders with premium benefits, dining, travel, and entertainment offers, along with comprehensive purchase and identity protections. The launch follows Bread Financial's recent introduction of a co-branded Mastercard with Victoria's Secret, expanding its credit solutions portfolio.

title: Ethisphere Recognises 2022 World's Most Ethical Companies
summary: Ethisphere has announced its 2022 list of the "World’s Most Ethical Companies," honoring 136 businesses across 22 countries and 45 industries. This 16th annual recognition highlights companies committed to ethical business practices that positively impact employees, communities, and sustainable performance. Notable companies include Starbucks, Accenture, and IBM, with the awards emphasizing leadership in sustainability, social issues, and governance.

title: Synchrony Financial stock falls Friday, underperforms market
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) stock fell 4.57% on Friday, closing at $37.98, underperforming both the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. This marks the third consecutive day of losses for the company, which is now $14.51 below its 52-week high. The stock also underperformed competitors like Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc., and FleetCor Technologies Inc.

title: CONSUMER FIRST ALERT: Ukraine email scam, Western Union refunds
summary: Scammers are exploiting the Ukraine war with a new email scam, claiming to be a refugee offering a share of $2 million in exchange for help accessing the funds. Consumer agencies warn against clicking links or responding to unsolicited emails, advising people to donate through legitimate organizations. Additionally, victims of past scams who sent money via Western Union between 2004 and 2017 still have until July 2022 to file a claim for a refund as part of a $586 million settlement.

title: The Next Big Visa-Mastercard Rival Is…Zelle?
summary: Payments industry experts are questioning if the Zelle P2P network will expand to point-of-sale transactions, potentially challenging Visa and Mastercard. Bank of America and Wells Fargo are reportedly lobbying for this expansion, which could help banks circumvent debit card fee restrictions from the Durbin Amendment. However, concerns exist about cannibalizing profitable credit card business and the lack of consumer protections and rewards offered by Zelle compared to cards.

title: Global Payments Partners with Bakkt, Offering Crypto and Loyalty Programmes
summary: Global Payments Inc. has partnered with Bakkt Holdings, Inc. to expand its cryptocurrency offerings, allowing its customers to pay using digital assets and integrate crypto into various payment solutions. This collaboration will also enable Global Payments to broaden its banking-as-a-service bankcard offerings to include customer access to cryptocurrencies. The partnership is part of Bakkt's ongoing efforts to boost crypto adoption within the payment ecosystem, following similar collaborations with American Bank, Wyndham Hotel, Google, and MasterCard.

title: Sanctions and their effect on international payments for insurers
summary: This article discusses the profound impact of sanctions imposed on Russia following its invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, especially on international payments for insurers. It details what sanctions are, their implications for the financial sector and businesses, and the challenges faced by the insurance industry, including FX volatility and difficulties in paying suppliers. The article also touches upon the performance of the Russian Ruble and future expectations regarding sanctions.

title: Santander y BBVA compiten con programas de apoyo al turismo
summary: Santander and BBVA are re-entering the travel financing market in Argentina with new programs to support tourism, following a period where funding for international trips was excluded. Banco Santander has partnered with Aerolíneas Argentinas to allow customers to convert SuperClub+ points into Aerolíneas Plus miles, while BBVA has launched its own points program for credit card consumption, redeemable for travel services. These initiatives come as the tourism sector experiences a significant recovery.

title: Santander lanza una funcionalidad pionera en su app y web para que los clientes puedan medir su huella de carbono
summary: Santander has launched a pioneering feature in its app and website, allowing customers in Spain to measure their carbon footprint based on purchases made with Santander cards and direct debits. The bank is the only entity in Spain that also enables customers to offset their carbon emissions by purchasing carbon credits through ClimateTrade and Mastercard's donations platform. This initiative is part of Santander's broader sustainability strategy to support clients in transitioning to a low-emission economy, with plans to expand the service to other European countries.

title: New feature on Santander website and app lets customers measure carbon footprint
summary: Santander has introduced a new feature on its website and app allowing customers to measure the carbon footprint of their direct debits and card purchases. This service is a first in Spain, also available in Chile, and will soon launch in Poland, Portugal, and the UK. Customers can also offset their emissions by purchasing carbon credits through ClimateTrade and Mastercard platforms, supporting projects reviewed by Santander.

title: Neo Financial Announces $185 Million Series C Raise at a Unicorn Valuation
summary: Neo Financial, a Canadian fintech company, announced a $185 million Series C fundraising round, valuing the company at over $1 billion. This brings their total funding to $299 million. The company has grown to over 1 million customers since its 2019 inception and plans to use the new funding to expand its product offerings, including a mortgage product, and strengthen its presence across Canada.

title: NONPROFIT REGISTER | Colorado Business Hall of Fame adds seven to its roster
summary: The Colorado Business Hall of Fame inducted seven new laureates at its 32nd annual event, hosted by Junior Achievement Rocky Mountain and the Denver Metro Chamber of Commerce. The inductees include entrepreneurs and philanthropists such as Robert Albin, Tim Gill, Robert Newman, Nancy and Curt Richardson, Donald Sturm, and Clara Brown, recognized for their significant contributions to business and society in Colorado.

title: Galileo Financial Technologies and Mastercard Strengthen Alliance in Latin America & Caribbean
summary: Galileo Financial Technologies and Mastercard have formed a multi-year strategic partnership to accelerate digital transformation and financial inclusion in Latin America and the Caribbean. This collaboration aims to empower fintechs and issuers in the region by combining their capabilities and infrastructure, making Galileo a preferred technology partner within Mastercard's Engage program. The initiative seeks to modernize payment solutions and support small and medium-sized enterprises in their digital transformation journeys.

title: Visa’s Expansion of Visa Ready for BNPL Reflects the Payment Method’s Growing Popularity
summary: Visa has expanded its Visa Ready program with Visa Ready for BNPL, including over 20 partners like ACI Worldwide and FIS. This initiative aims to accelerate the implementation and scalability of Visa's Buy Now, Pay Later offerings for both issuers and merchants. The expansion comes as the BNPL market is projected to reach $1.6 trillion globally, highlighting the payment method's increasing significance.

title: Google’s New Wallet Digitizes Payment Cards Plus Drivers’ Licenses And Other Credentials
summary: Google has launched a new Google Wallet, aiming to digitize not only payment cards but also various other credentials like driver's licenses, vaccine cards, transit passes, hotel keys, and office badges. The new wallet is a core part of the Android mobile operating system and integrates with Wear OS, with plans to expand its capabilities and availability. Key features include ease of access, rich customer experiences, and enhanced security through biometric authentication or PINs.

title: Mastercard Economics Institute: Pent-up demand drives global leisure and business flight bookings past 2019 levels
summary: A new report from the Mastercard Economics Institute, "Travel 2022: Trends and Transitions," reveals that global leisure and business flight bookings have exceeded pre-pandemic levels. The research, covering 37 markets, indicates that if current trends continue, an estimated 1.5 billion more passengers will fly globally in 2022 compared to the previous year. Key findings also show a strong rebound in spending on cruises, buses, and trains, with a significant shift in tourist spending towards experiences rather than material goods.

title: $131 Million in Settlements Approved for Distribution in Credit Card Interchange Fees Class Action
summary: Courts have approved the distribution of $131 million in net settlements for a class action against Visa, Mastercard, and several banks regarding credit card interchange fees. The lawsuit alleged a conspiracy to fix fees and restrict merchants' ability to surcharge higher-cost cards. Canadian businesses that accepted Visa or Mastercard between March 23, 2001, and September 2, 2021, are eligible to claim settlement benefits, with an easier process for small merchants.

title: Amex isn't afraid of inflation
summary: American Express CEO Steve Squeri expressed confidence in the company's customer base and economic outlook despite inflation concerns. Squeri noted that Amex has not seen any significant deterioration in credit quality and that card member spending grew 35% in the first quarter, believing that pulling back on investment is not the right strategy. The company also observes a growing premium card market, attracting younger consumers willing to pay annual fees for value.

title: Airfares surge 50% as domestic and international travel rebound
summary: Airfares for major domestic carriers have surged by nearly 50% compared to a year ago due to a combination of high demand, increased fuel costs, staffing shortages, and smaller fleets. Despite rising costs for airlines, consumer demand for both domestic and international travel has rebounded to pre-pandemic levels. Industry experts note that strained capacity and a surplus in demand are the primary drivers behind the escalating ticket prices.

title: A wholly owned subsidiary of Apple will extend loans for its Pay Later service
summary: Apple's new Pay Later service will have a wholly owned subsidiary handle credit checks and short-term loans, signaling the company's deeper push into financial services. While Apple is partnering with Mastercard and Goldman Sachs, it will manage the lending decisions and balance sheet itself. This move aims to make the iPhone ecosystem more valuable to users and is part of Apple's strategy to bring fintech infrastructure in-house.

title: Gap Inc. Launches New Credit Card Program in Partnership with Barclays and Mastercard
summary: Gap Inc. has launched a new credit card program in partnership with Barclays US Consumer Bank and Mastercard. This program allows cardmembers to earn points across Gap Inc. brands and anywhere Mastercard is accepted, with special reward tiers and benefits. The initiative also includes a "Do Good" component for charitable donations and features credit cards made with recycled ocean-bound plastic.

title: Abra announces US crypto rewards credit card on Amex network
summary: Abra and American Express have partnered to launch the Abra Crypto Card, the first US crypto rewards credit card on the Amex network. This card will allow users to earn cryptocurrency rewards, including Abra's native CPRX token, on their USD purchases. The initiative aims to attract both experienced crypto users and newcomers by offering a simple entry point into the crypto world through an established financial network.

title: Priority Destinations Pro: Full Ala Moana Bowls Briefing
summary: The Priority Destinations Pro presented by First Hawaiian Bank and Mastercard offers a significant opportunity for surfers in the WSL Hawaii/Tahiti Nui region to earn points for the Challenger Series. This event, held at Ala Moana Bowls from June 17-24, marks the return of a QS event to the famed location and includes women competitors for the first time at this level. The article highlights the event's history at Bowls, featuring past winners and promising a star-studded lineup of current and emerging talent, with a favorable forecast for strong waves.

title: Mastercard Celebrates Pride Month with Your True Self is Priceless Campaign
summary: Mastercard is celebrating Pride Month with its "Your True Self is Priceless" campaign, featuring live events at New York City Pride, social media activations, and immersive metaverse experiences in Decentraland and Meta’s Horizon Worlds. The campaign encourages the LGBTQIA+ community to write letters to their younger selves, building on Mastercard's commitment to inclusivity which includes the 2019 True Name feature. Events span from sponsoring Pride Island and the NYC Pride March to offering Priceless Experiences with celebrity chefs and virtual engagements in the metaverse.

title: Former Mastercard and Afterpay exec Zahir Khoja to become CEO of Wave Inc
summary: Zahir Khoja, former General Manager, North America at Afterpay and Executive Vice President at MasterCard, is set to become CEO of Wave Inc. effective July 1. He will succeed Kirk Simpson, who co-founded Wave in 2009 and is stepping down at the end of June. Khoja will report to H&R Block President and CEO Jeff Jones and plans to focus on providing valuable financial management tools to small business owners.

title: ACLEDA Bank Plc. Partners with MoneyGram to Enable Cross-Border Remittances via ACLEDA Mobile
summary: ACLEDA Bank Plc. has announced a partnership with MoneyGram International, Inc. to enable cross-border remittances via the ACLEDA mobile app. This collaboration allows customers in Cambodia to send money to over 200 countries and territories and receive international transfers directly through the app, with future plans for cash services at bank branches. The partnership aims to enhance financial inclusion and provide fast, convenient, and reliable money transfer solutions for customers.

title: Western Union refunds! If you wired money to a scammer, you could get your money back.
summary: Western Union has agreed to pay $586 million in refunds to consumers scammed through its service, following a joint investigation by federal agencies. If you wired money to a scammer via Western Union between January 2004 and January 19, 2017, you may be eligible for a refund. Claims must be filed by July 1, 2022, and the FTC provides details on how to apply, with many eligible individuals receiving pre-filled claim forms.

title: Gap Inc. Launches New Credit Card Program in Partnership with Barclays and Mastercard
summary: Gap Inc. has launched a new credit card program in partnership with Barclays and Mastercard, enabling customers to earn points across its brands and beyond. This program offers enhanced rewards, including bonus points for new cardholders and benefits like free shipping and exclusive access, with a focus on sustainability through recycled card plastic and a "Do Good" component for charitable donations. The new cards, which offer no annual fee and fraud liability protection, will be rolled out to existing Cardmembers and are available for new applicants, replacing previous cards by June 20, 2022.

title: Western Union Co. stock rises Friday, outperforms market
summary: Western Union Co. (WU) stock rose 4.90% on Friday to $16.69, outperforming the broader market indexes like the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. The company's stock closed $6.99 below its 52-week high, and its trading volume was higher than its 50-day average. Competitors such as Mastercard, Fidelity National Information Services, and Global Payments also saw gains.

title: Eye on Mastercard: Paysafe Adds Send; PayPal Launches a Cashback Mastercard
summary: Paysafe Ltd. is integrating Mastercard Send into its platform to offer international and domestic payout services to merchants in the UK and Europe, enabling them to send payments to various destinations. Concurrently, PayPal Holdings Inc. has launched the PayPal Business Cashback Mastercard, which offers 2% cashback on all purchases with no annual fee, providing small businesses with additional financing options. Both initiatives aim to enhance payment flexibility and cater to evolving consumer and business needs, especially post-pandemic.

title: New PayPal cashback business credit card launches for US SMBs
summary: PayPal has introduced a new business credit card, the PayPal Business Cashback Mastercard, aimed at US small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). This card, issued by WebBank and powered by Mastercard, offers 2% cashback on all purchases with no annual fee or rewards caps, providing immediate virtual access to approved businesses. The initiative expands PayPal's credit offerings to support SMBs with flexible financing and rewards, developed in collaboration with Concerto Card Company, WebBank, and Mastercard.

title: Synchrony Financial stock outperforms market on strong trading day
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) stock increased by 3.51% to $28.59, outperforming the broader market which also saw gains with the S&P 500 rising by 1.06% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average by 1.05%. This rise ended a four-day losing streak for the company. The stock closed significantly below its 52-week high, but still outperformed competitors like Visa, Mastercard, and FleetCor Technologies on the trading day.

title: Meet Westchester’s CEOs & Business Leaders of the Year in 2022
summary: This article highlights Westchester County's top CEOs and business leaders for 2022 across various sectors including for-profit companies, non-profit organizations, healthcare, government, and education. It showcases individuals recognized for their innovation, leadership, and significant contributions to their respective fields and the community, detailing their achievements and impact. The featured leaders include Leonard Schleifer of Regeneron, Michael Miebach of Mastercard, George Latimer as County Executive, and Dr. Belinda Miles of Westchester Community College, among others.

title: SABB and Mastercard launch World Elite Exclusive Credit Card
summary: The Saudi British Bank (SABB) and Mastercard have launched the World Elite Exclusive Mastercard credit card, offering private banking customers a wide range of market-exclusive benefits and privileges. This partnership aims to provide exceptional services for shopping, leisure, travel, and reward programs, redefining Saudi financial services and the Kingdom's payments sector. The initiative is part of SABB's strategy to maintain its leading market position and enhance the banking experience for its customers.

title: Apple Pay: The ultimate guide
summary: This comprehensive guide details Apple Pay, Apple's digital payment system designed to replace physical cards and cash with enhanced security and privacy. It covers setting up Apple Pay, utilizing the Wallet app, and explores related features such as Apple Card, Apple Cash, Apple Pay Express Transit, Apple Tap to Pay, and Apple Pay Later. The article highlights Apple Pay's evolution beyond contactless payments and its aim to simplify financial transactions.

title: As Carr Steps Down at Beyond, Former TSYS Executive Mike Peters Takes Over As CEO
summary: Mike Peters, former chief executive of TSYS Merchant Solutions, has taken over as CEO of Beyond Inc., succeeding founder Robert O. Carr. Carr will remain executive chairman of the company and plans to dedicate more time to a non-profit organization. Peters aims to strengthen Beyond's sales and technology operations, building upon Carr's established model.

title: Payment solutions for fuel providers
summary: J.P. Morgan's article addresses the evolving challenges and opportunities for fuel providers in the payments landscape. It highlights the complexities of managing multiple payment systems in fuel retail, the financial burden of swipe fees and fraud, and the need for modernization. The article suggests that adopting new payment models, leveraging mobile apps, and offering diversified services like EV charging can help fuel retailers attract and retain customers and optimize operational costs.

title: Tuya y Bancolombia lideran en número de tarjetas de crédito vigentes a abril
summary: Tuya and Bancolombia lead in the number of active credit cards in Colombia as of April, according to a report from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC). The country had 15.97 million active credit cards, with Mastercard having the most by franchise. Experts advise caution when using credit cards due to rising interest rates tied to the usury rate.

title: Taiwan edge AI company Gorilla Technology IPO surges 123% on first day of Nasdaq trading
summary: Taiwanese edge AI company Gorilla Technology Group saw its IPO surge 123% on its first day of Nasdaq trading, closing at US$33.43 under the ticker "GRRR." The company plans to use the proceeds from its business combination with Global SPAC Partners for working capital and international expansion, aiming to form a "Smart City Diverse Industry Alliance" to expand global markets for edge AI analytics solutions. Gorilla Technology has developed its edge AI technology over 20 years, holding 31 patents, and provides comprehensive video-centric and content management solutions across various sectors with key partnerships including Softbank, Intel, and Dell.

title: Mastercard partners with D-Wave for quantum computing trials
summary: Mastercard has formed a multi-year strategic alliance with D-Wave to explore quantum computing applications in financial services. They will collaborate on areas like consumer loyalty, cross-border settlement, and fraud detection using D-Wave's quantum annealing technology. The partnership aims to leverage quantum computing's power for optimization problems to deliver personalized experiences and tackle complex financial challenges.

title: Visa’s profits jump 32% as consumers start traveling again
summary: Visa Inc. reported a 32% increase in fiscal third-quarter profits, driven by a double-digit rise in money processed on its credit and debit card network. The company earned $3.4 billion, or $1.60 per share, exceeding analyst expectations. This growth was largely attributed to a significant 40% increase in cross-border payments, indicating a return to pre-pandemic international travel habits.

title: The need for customer centric government just got real. Thankfully, the support is already here.
summary: Pegasystems has been assisting leading brands for nearly four decades in solving significant challenges and transforming for the future. The company is now applying its industry-leading AI-powered decision and workflow automation capabilities to the public sector in over 20 countries, including Australia, to enhance digital customer service. Through case studies like the UK Royal Navy, US Department of Agriculture, Services Australia, and the NSW ePlanning Portal, the article highlights Pega's success in streamlining processes, improving citizen engagement, and driving efficiency and cost savings in government services.

title: The Future of Modern Payments Processing is Here: Moov Financial Joins Forces with Visa and Pathward to Improve Payments and Onboarding Experience for ISV's
summary: Moov Financial has announced its launch as a direct merchant acquiring processor on the Visa network, partnering with Pathward N.A. (formerly MetaBank). This collaboration aims to simplify and accelerate the payments and onboarding experience for integrated software vendors (ISV's), offering a quick path to card processing and other services. Moov's modern technology allows for fast merchant onboarding and account creation, bypassing traditional intermediaries.

title: The Future of Modern Payments Processing is Here: Moov Financial Joins Forces with Visa and Pathward to Improve Payments and Onboarding Experience for ISV's
summary: Moov Financial has announced its launch as a direct merchant acquiring processor on the Visa network, partnering with Pathward N.A. This collaboration aims to enhance payment processing and onboarding experiences for platform, vertical SaaS, and fintech companies by providing a streamlined path to card processing and other services. Moov's modern and modular technology enables quick merchant onboarding and direct connection to the Visa network.

title: FleetCor Technologies Inc. stock rises Friday, still underperforms market
summary: Shares of FleetCor Technologies Inc. (FLT) rose 0.14% on Friday, closing at $220.09, despite an overall positive trading session for the market. However, the stock underperformed its competitors like Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc., and Fidelity National Information Services Inc. FleetCor Technologies Inc. also remained $61.93 short of its 52-week high.

title: Splitit Expands BNPL To Rent Payments And Relocates Global Base To Atlanta
summary: Splitit USA Inc. has partnered with letus to expand its buy now, pay later (BNPL) services to rent payments and security deposits. This collaboration allows tenants to spread payments over interest-free monthly installments, utilizing Splitit's "Installments-as-a-Service" platform without requiring credit checks. Additionally, Splitit is moving its global headquarters from New York to Atlanta, a significant hub for financial technology companies.

title: Disney class action alleges Visa, Mastercard charge high transaction fees
summary: The Walt Disney Co. has filed a class action lawsuit against Visa and Mastercard, alleging that the payment companies colluded to force merchants to pay excessively high transaction fees for over a decade, violating antitrust laws. Disney claims these "interchange fees" are supracompetitive and seeks damages, fees, and costs, arguing that more competition between card-issuers would benefit both merchants and consumers. This action follows Disney's decision to opt out of a previous $6 billion multidistrict litigation settlement with Visa and Mastercard regarding similar fee-fixing allegations.

title: PVH Corp. Appoints Ajay Bhalla to Its Board of Directors
summary: PVH Corp. announced the appointment of Ajay Bhalla, President of Cyber & Intelligence at Mastercard International, to its Board of Directors. This appointment is part of the Board's ongoing refreshment process and supports PVH's multi-year PVH+ Plan, which aims to accelerate growth for its iconic brands Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER. Bhalla brings extensive digital commerce and cybersecurity expertise, crucial for the digital components of PVH's strategy.

title: Visa Suspends PornHub Parent Company’s Advertising Arm From Payments Network Amidst Child Pornography Lawsuit
summary: Payments giant Visa has suspended TrafficJunky, the advertising arm of MindGeek, from its network following a child pornography lawsuit. This decision comes after a California district judge ruled against Visa's motion to dismiss itself from a case involving Serena Fleites, who was underage when an explicit video of her appeared on Pornhub. Visa stated that its cards cannot be used to purchase advertising on MindGeek affiliated sites until further notice.

title: Geopagos, fintech argentina de aceptación de pagos, levantó US$35 millones • Contxto
summary: Geopagos, an Argentine fintech specializing in payment acceptance solutions, has raised $35 million in its first institutional financing round led by Riverwood Capital. The company, founded in 2013, provides technology for businesses to launch or scale their payment processing operations in 15 Latin American countries. This investment will accelerate Geopagos's growth across the region and increase R&D efforts.

title: REI Co-op and Capital One Announce New REI Co-op Mastercard
summary: REI Co-op and Capital One have introduced a new REI Co-op Mastercard program, offering enhanced rewards and benefits for co-op members and outdoor enthusiasts. The card provides 5% back on REI purchases, 1.5% everywhere else, no annual or foreign transaction fees, and a welcome bonus. This partnership also supports the REI Cooperative Action Fund and aligns with both companies' values in community engagement, financial well-being, and sustainability.

title: BitPay Launches a Rewards Program for Its Crypto-Based Prepaid Card
summary: BitPay has launched a rewards program for its crypto-based prepaid card, offering up to 15% cash back on purchases at participating merchants. Cardholders can load the card using cryptocurrency through the BitPay Wallet app, which converts it to fiat currency at the point of sale. While the program aims to incentivize consumer crypto use, questions remain regarding merchant acceptance and reward funding.

title: Telus seeks CRTC approval to charge customers a fee for credit card payments
summary: Telus Corp. is seeking CRTC approval to implement a 1.5% processing fee for customers paying with a credit card, intending to cover the associated processing costs. This move follows a class action settlement with Visa and Mastercard, allowing merchants to add surcharges starting October 6th. The fee, estimated at $2 per customer monthly, will not apply in Quebec or to Koodo customers, and can be avoided by using other payment methods like debit.

title: Pomelo Launches Family Credit Cards to Combine Credit and International Money Transfer
summary: Pomelo is introducing a new family credit card system that allows primary accountholders to issue up to four cards to friends and family overseas, eliminating international money transfer fees by using credit rails. The company, launched with $70 million in Seed funding, aims to help users build credit in the U.S. while providing financial access to loved ones in emerging economies. The service is initially available for transfers between the U.S. and the Philippines, where users can manage spending limits and track card usage via an app.

title: NYC's Newest Performance Venue Midnight Theatre Sets Official Opening Date on September 21 and Partners with Mastercard as Presenting Sponsor
summary: Midnight Theatre, a new 160-seat performance venue in Manhattan West, is set to officially open on September 21, 2022. Mastercard will serve as the presenting sponsor, offering exclusive multisensory experiences to cardholders. Dolphin Entertainment (NASDAQ: DLPN) holds an ownership stake and will manage the venue's marketing and publicity.

title: FIS to Modernize Real-Time Payments Infrastructure and Central Bank Digital Currencies for Countries Around the World
