summary: FIS has launched RealNet™ Central, a new central infrastructure payment solution designed to help central banks modernize or build real-time payment networks globally. Additionally, FIS is introducing a Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDC) Virtual Lab in collaboration with M10 Networks, enabling countries to experiment with and accelerate CBDC implementations. These initiatives aim to transform nations into digital, real-time inclusive economies and advance how the world pays.

title: Clearance Holders Flagged by Feds for Gaming Credit Card Rewards
summary: This article discusses how individuals game credit card rewards programs by purchasing gift cards, converting them to money orders, and paying off credit card balances, generating significant tax-free income. It highlights the risks for security clearance holders who engage in this activity, as banks may file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) due to large cash infusions. While not illegal, these SARs can lead to scrutiny during security clearance background investigations, potentially causing denials or revocations despite the activity's legality.

title: FIS adds real-time payments, CBDC services
summary: FIS has launched a new software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform to help central banks worldwide implement or update their real-time payment systems. Five countries have already adopted this service, and a sixth is planned for implementation later in the year. Additionally, FIS is offering its virtual lab to assist central banks in exploring and integrating their own central bank digital currencies (CBDCs).

title: Card companies urged to code gun sellers
summary: Public officials and pension funds are increasing pressure on Visa, Mastercard, and American Express to create a unique merchant category code (MCC) for gun sellers. Proponents argue this code would help financial institutions track suspicious gun purchases, citing past incidents where firearms used in mass shootings were bought with credit cards. The International Standards Organization (ISO), which sets MCC standards, is considering the matter, while card companies remain largely uncommitted to publicly supporting the initiative.

title: SRM (Strategic Resource Management) Welcomes Former Director of Payments at NatWest Marion King to International Advisory Board
summary: SRM (Strategic Resource Management) has appointed Marion King, former Director of Payments at NatWest, to its International Advisory Board. King brings 25 years of experience from companies like Mastercard and Reuters, and her expertise will help SRM expand its services, particularly in Europe. This appointment is part of SRM's strategic growth plan to enhance its advisory services in payments, operations, technology, and digital assets.

title: Visa, Mastercard and AmEx to Start Categorizing Gun Shop Sales
summary: Visa announced it will adopt a new merchant code to separately categorize gun shop sales, a move also planned by Mastercard and American Express. This decision is seen as a significant victory by gun control advocates who believe it will help track suspicious firearm purchases, but it is expected to face opposition from gun rights advocates. The new categorization follows pressure from New York City officials and pension funds, aiming to create better oversight similar to codes already in place for various other types of retail transactions.

title: Western Union Co. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
summary: Western Union Co. (WU) stock rose 2.68% to $15.31 on a strong trading day, outperforming the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. This marks the stock's fourth consecutive day of gains, closing $6.56 below its 52-week high. While showing mixed performance against some competitors, its trading volume exceeded its 50-day average.

title: Apple Pay llegaría a fines de octubre a Chile
summary: Apple Pay is expected to launch in Chile by the end of October, according to financial industry executives and various indications. Several banks, including Banco de Chile, Bci, Banco Falabella, Itaú, BICE, Scotiabank, and Santander, are preparing for its arrival. The delay has been attributed to commercial differences, particularly Apple's demand for a share of transaction commissions, and technical implementation challenges related to Chile's evolving payment system and POS terminal requirements.

title: The Global Real-Time Rail Ecosystem (Part I)
summary: This article, Part I of a series, explores the global landscape of real-time payment rail modernization. It highlights Canada's modernization journey and reviews faster payment systems in the UK, Australia, Hong Kong, and the United States, detailing the innovative services built upon these infrastructures. The article emphasizes that while the introduction of Real-Time Rails (RTR) is a significant step, it is merely the beginning of a broader modernization process with extensive economic implications.

title: Visa eyes B2B, remittances for growth
summary: Visa is targeting the business-to-business (B2B) and remittances markets for significant future growth, as stated by CFO Vasant Prabhu at a Goldman Sachs conference. The company sees a substantial "cardable B2B portion" opportunity and is also expanding its network for remittances, aiming to improve efficiency, speed, and cost-effectiveness in these markets. Visa plans to challenge incumbents and fintechs by offering faster and cheaper solutions for cross-border money transfers.

title: As ISVs disrupt payments, can merchant acquirers stay relevant?
summary: Integrated Software Vendors (ISVs) are rapidly gaining market share in the US merchant acquiring business, particularly among small businesses, by offering software-driven solutions that combine payment processing with business management and value-added services. This trend poses significant challenges to incumbent merchant acquirers and banks, who risk losing direct relationships and revenue opportunities as ISVs capture customer loyalty. The article explores how traditional players, ISVs themselves, and investors can adapt to this evolving landscape, highlighting opportunities for growth through partnerships, expanded service offerings, and strategic investments in niche markets.

title: Galicia y Naranja X entran al mercado de las plataformas de pagos
summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia, including Banco Galicia and Naranja X, has launched "Nave," a new payment platform targeting the virtual payments market. This platform aims to provide solutions for businesses, including microcredits for users without traditional credit cards ("buy now, pay later") and real-time accreditation for merchants at low commission rates. The initiative seeks to expand digital tools for businesses and compete in the QR code payment segment, with plans to integrate more digital services and payment options.

title: Paying with a credit card? Expect to see a fee when you shop under new rules that start now
summary: Canadian retailers and businesses are now permitted to charge customers a surcharge of up to 2.4% for credit card transactions, following a class-action lawsuit settlement. This new rule aims to offset the interchange fees merchants previously had to absorb, although it may lead some consumers to switch to debit or cash payments. Quebec is exempt from these new rules due to its Consumer Protection Act, and merchants must provide notice before implementing surcharges.

title: BJ's Wholesale Club Introduces New Partnership with Capital One
summary: BJ's Wholesale Club and Capital One Financial have formed a strategic partnership, making Capital One the exclusive issuing partner for BJ's Mastercard program, set to launch in early 2023. This agreement includes Capital One acquiring BJ's existing credit card accounts. The partnership aims to enhance member value through improved customer service, digital offerings, and an upgraded value proposition.

title: Sam's Club Credit Card Login & Payment Info [Pay Bill]
summary: This article provides a comprehensive guide to managing Sam's Club credit cards, covering application, rewards, online login, and various payment methods. It details the benefits of both the Sam's Club Mastercard and store card, emphasizing the Synchrony Bank association. The guide also offers contact information for customer service and answers frequently asked questions regarding payments and rewards.

title: Embedded finance: Who will lead the next payments revolution?
summary: Embedded finance, which integrates financial products into nonfinancial digital experiences, reached $20 billion in US revenues in 2021 and is projected to double within three to five years. The article explores how banks, payments providers, fintechs, and software firms can participate and succeed in this dynamic market by focusing on product breadth, depth, and program management support. Key success factors include choosing a strategic focus, building a modern developer experience, adapting to B2B2C/B2B2B sales, and developing robust support and risk services.

title: Surcharging and What It Means For Your Business
summary: This article explains credit card surcharging for businesses, detailing how merchants can add a fee for credit card transactions following a class action lawsuit settlement with Visa and Mastercard. It outlines eligibility criteria for the settlement, how to claim, and provides guidance on how to implement surcharging, including notification and disclosure requirements. The article also addresses frequently asked questions regarding surcharging, such as what it is, how it differs from convenience fees, and regional restrictions like those in Quebec.

title: Women’s path to leadership: Still a leaky pipeline for India Inc.
summary: The Avtar Group and Seramount's seventh edition of the Best Companies for Women in India (BCWI) report highlights an increasing representation of women at entry-level positions but a significant drop at managerial and senior levels in India Inc. The study, which included 351 companies, also identified the Champions of Inclusion for 2022. Despite robust career enhancement programs, a "leaky pipeline" persists, emphasizing the need for concerted organizational and societal efforts to build women's leadership.

title: Media Alert: Adobe Delivers Powerful New Creative, Document and Marketing Capabilities for SMBs
summary: Adobe announced new automation and collaboration features across Adobe Creative Cloud and the Adobe product portfolio, aimed at helping small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) modernize workflows and enhance productivity. The company also unveiled new partnerships with Mastercard, Etsy, and Meta to extend access to Adobe Creative Cloud and Adobe Document Cloud for SMBs. These innovations and partnerships address the growing reliance of SMBs on digital solutions amid labor shortages and increasing uncertainty, providing tools to simplify tasks, improve collaboration, and automate marketing efforts.

title: Nubank Becomes the Latest Latin American Company to Launch a Cryptocurrency
summary: Brazilian fintech Nubank, backed by Warren Buffett, has announced the launch of its own digital currency, Nucoin, on the Polygon blockchain network. Scheduled for release in the first half of 2023, Nucoin will be distributed to customers for free and will form the basis of a benefits program in Brazil. This move follows MercadoLibre's launch of Mercado Coin and highlights a growing trend among Latin American companies to integrate cryptocurrencies into loyalty programs, despite the ongoing "crypto winter."

title: Jack Henry and Mastercard Expand Collaboration to Address Financial Fragmentation
summary: Jack Henry and Mastercard have expanded their collaboration to help community and regional financial institutions provide accountholders with a consolidated view of their financial experiences. This partnership utilizes Mastercard's open banking platform with Finicity services to address financial fragmentation and empower consumers and businesses with more informed financial decisions. The initiative aims to place financial institutions at the center of accountholders' financial lives, particularly as financial fragmentation increasingly complicates personal finance.

title: Mastercard Teams up With Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever to Spotlight Small Business Superheroes
summary: Mastercard has partnered with Marvel Studios' "Black Panther: Wakanda Forever" to celebrate Black excellence and the strength of Black women, both on and off-screen. This collaboration spotlights Black women small business owners, like Egypt Otis of Comma Bookstore & Social Hub, through a Wakanda-inspired commercial and various initiatives. Mastercard's efforts extend its $500 million commitment to close the racial wealth and economic gap in the U.S. by supporting Black women-owned businesses through the Strivers Initiative, exclusive screenings, and new digital platforms like the Mastercard Small Biz Marketplace on Instagram and a Small Business Metaverse platform.

title: How commercial cards help keep fraud at bay
summary: J.P. Morgan discusses how commercial cards can help businesses mitigate payment fraud, which affected 71% of finance professionals in 2021. The article highlights built-in security features of commercial cards, such as chip technology and customizable spending limits, and educates on common fraud schemes like business email compromise, account takeover, skimming, data breaches, phishing, and internet safety. It also promotes virtual card solutions as an enhanced security measure, citing their near 0% fraud rate due to unique account numbers, secure vendor access, controlled credit limits, and custom expiration dates.

title: Western Union files trademark applications as it seeks to foray into digital asset sector
summary: Western Union has filed three trademark applications with the United States Patent and Trademark Office, signaling a potential move into the digital asset sector. The filings suggest the company is considering issuing its own digital tokens, maintaining digital currency wallets, and offering virtual currency exchange and trading services. This move comes despite past hesitations and puts Western Union in a competitive race with companies like Mastercard and Visa who have already made significant strides in digital asset offerings.

title: American Express just hired a new tech executive who was the CTO at Groupon and led tech at Goldman Sachs' Marcus
summary: American Express has hired Sachin Devand as EVP and unit CIO of digital, data, and AI/ML tech. Devand previously served as CTO of Groupon for eight months and before that, was a managing director and CTO of Marcus, Goldman Sachs' online-only consumer bank. His role at Amex will focus on leveraging data and machine learning, which are critical for the company's digital payments strategy and fraud prevention given its end-to-end data set.

title: Amtrak and First National Bank of Omaha Launch Two New Amtrak Guest Rewards Mastercards
summary: Amtrak and First National Bank of Omaha (FNBO) have launched two new Amtrak Guest Rewards Mastercard Credit Cards. These co-branded cards offer enhanced benefits and rewards for Amtrak loyalty program members, allowing them to earn points for travel, upgrades, dining, and more. The new offerings include a Preferred Mastercard with an annual fee and a standard Mastercard with no annual fee, both designed to improve the customer travel experience.

title: PayPal's "prudent" revenue growth forecast cut sinks shares
summary: PayPal cut its annual revenue growth forecast from 11% to 10% for the year, citing a challenging macro environment, slowing e-commerce, and an unpredictable holiday shopping season. This "prudent" forecast and a decline in third-quarter profit led to an 11% drop in shares, though they later pared losses to 9%. The company expects to achieve $900 million in cost savings this year and at least $1.3 billion next year, amid concerns over consumer spending tightening due to inflation and recession fears.

title: Jerry McElhatton Obituary (1939 - 2022)
summary: Jerry McElhatton, born in 1939, passed away on October 31, 2022, after a brief battle with pancreatic cancer. He is remembered as a devoted husband and family man, survived by his wife Jane of 57 years, their three children, and five grandchildren. Jerry had a distinguished career in technology, holding leadership positions at companies like Precision Response Corporation and MasterCard Worldwide Global Technology and Operations, and was involved with numerous corporate and charitable boards.

title: 3 Reasons Investors Should Look to Emerging Markets
summary: Emerging market stocks, despite a challenging year, are positioned for a potential rebound in 2023. This resurgence is anticipated due to China's likely shift towards pro-growth and stimulus-oriented policies, the expected weakening of the U.S. dollar, and evolving global trade relationships creating new opportunities for EM nations outside of China. Investors are encouraged to reassess their exposure to emerging markets, particularly focusing on China onshore companies, South Korea, Taiwan, and Brazil.

title: John Boris Appointed as Tripadvisor's Chief Marketing Officer
summary: Tripadvisor has appointed John Boris, a veteran in e-commerce, travel, and hospitality, as its new Chief Marketing Officer. In this role, Boris will lead the platform's B2C and B2B marketing strategy, focusing on customer acquisition, engagement, brand resonance, and international growth. His previous experience includes C-suite positions at Shutterfly, Zagat, Lonely Planet Americas, and IfOnly, bringing a strong track record of building and transforming global brands.

title: How Canada’s new credit card surcharge will affect consumers and businesses
summary: Canada's recent removal of the credit card no-surcharge rule, following a class-action lawsuit settlement, allows businesses to pass interchange fees to customers. This article explores the potential impact on consumers and businesses, discussing consumer reactions based on behavioral economics, and suggesting strategies for businesses like offering cash discounts instead of surcharges. It also suggests that surcharges could improve consumer decision-making by making the true cost of credit card use more transparent.

title: Tripadvisor names John Borris as new CMO
summary: Tripadvisor has appointed John Borris, an experienced professional in the technology, travel, and hospitality sectors, as its new Chief Marketing Officer. Borris will be responsible for the company's B2C and B2B marketing strategy, focusing on customer acquisition, engagement, and brand reach. His previous roles include leadership positions at Shutterfly and Zagat, and he will report directly to Tripadvisor CEO Matt Goldberg.

title: Global Electronic Bill Presentment and Payment Market is expected to foresee significant growth. APAC to lead the growth!
summary: The Global Electronic Bill Presentment and Payment (EBPP) Market is projected to experience significant growth, driven by the increasing adoption of electronic payment solutions and rising smartphone usage. Asia-Pacific is expected to lead this growth due to emerging economies and digitalization efforts. Key market drivers include the efficiency of managing expenses and the optimization of human resources, with mobile, web, and email channels being primary communication methods for bill presentment.

title: HP, Aon, and Liberty Bank are piloting a new apprenticeship program to help fill the finance talent pipeline
summary: HP, Aon, and Liberty Bank are participating in a new apprenticeship program, "Registered Apprenticeship for Finance Business Partners," launched by the American Institute of CPAs (AICPA) and the U.S. Department of Labor. This program aims to address the finance talent gap and upskill professionals at all career levels, providing them with job-ready skills and leading to the Chartered Global Management Accountant (CGMA) designation. The pilot program will start in 2023 with companies like Aon focusing on early career finance colleagues and HP, Inc. hiring graduates from historically Black colleges and universities.

title: The lines between Food & Grocery delivery continue to blur
summary: The article discusses the blurring lines between food and grocery delivery services as major third-party delivery platforms expand their offerings. It highlights DoorDash's significant growth in attracting new digital visitors and its effective use of influencers, as well as the strategic partnerships between credit card issuers like Chase and Mastercard with Instacart and DoorDash to incentivize market growth.

title: Mastercard loses UK ruling on three million dead claimants in $12 bln case
summary: Mastercard lost an appeal in a London court concerning a collective action lawsuit exceeding 10 billion pounds ($12 billion-plus), which permits claims from approximately three million deceased individuals to proceed. The lawsuit, brought by consumer champion Walter Merricks on behalf of 46 million UK adults, alleges Mastercard charged excessive "interchange" fees between 1992 and 2008 that were passed on to consumers. Mastercard has stated it will continue to fight the case, while Merricks' lawyer lauded the judgment as a step towards securing billions in damages for UK consumers.

title: FIS, Fiserv could benefit from credit legislation
summary: New legislation aimed at increasing competition in credit card routing, the Credit Card Competition Act of 2022, could significantly benefit payment processing companies FIS and Fiserv. Currently, these firms primarily handle debit transactions, but the bill seeks to challenge the dominance of Visa and Mastercard in the credit market by requiring merchants to have access to at least two unaffiliated networks. While the feasibility of its passage and the technological readiness of FIS and Fiserv remain points of discussion, proponents argue it could open new revenue streams for these companies by allowing them to extend their existing debit networks into credit processing.

title: The clearing house standard: Aspirational model for accounting firms and retailers
summary: Accounting firms, particularly those serving the retail industry, should adopt a "clearing house mentality" to improve the accuracy of client bookkeeping and save them money. This approach involves daily reconciliation of sales and deposits, similar to the highly regulated investment industry, to address the complexities of modern e-commerce and diverse payment platforms. By educating clients and leveraging automation, firms can provide a more robust reconciliation experience, preventing financial discrepancies and ensuring better financial health for retailers.

title: Brad Miller Joins Moderna as Chief Information Officer
summary: Moderna, Inc. has announced the appointment of Brad Miller as Chief Information Officer, effective January 3, 2023. Miller will join Moderna's Executive Committee, reporting to CEO Stéphane Bancel. He takes over from Marcello Damiani, the current Chief Digital Officer, who will be retiring in March after seven and a half years with the company.

title: Moderna hires Capital One exec as new CIO
summary: Moderna has announced the appointment of Brad Miller, formerly of Capital One, as its new CIO, effective January 3. Miller will replace Marcello Damiani, who is set to retire in March. Miller's experience in digital and IT solutions is expected to support Moderna's global growth, building on their previous digital transformation initiatives, including partnering with AWS.

title: Mastercard, Fiserv and more: These payments stocks dubbed favorites for 2023
summary: Bank of America and RBC Capital Markets analysts have identified their top picks in the payments sector for the upcoming year, with Mastercard and Fiserv appearing on both lists. Analysts noted Mastercard's resilience, highlighting its revenue and earnings per share growth even during the 2009 fiscal year. Fiserv was cited for its "unique distribution channel."

title: UK Class Action certification
summary: This article discusses the development of the UK's statutory class action regime since 2015, particularly focusing on competition law claims. It highlights the impact of the Supreme Court's ruling in Merricks v Mastercard, which lowered the certification threshold, leading to a significant increase in class action filings. The piece also examines the intricacies of the collective proceedings order (CPO) process, challenges faced during certification, and the potential implications for future cases and settlements.

title: Mercurity Fintech Holding Inc. Announces a $5.98 Million Asset Purchase Agreement for the Creation of Web3 Infrastructure
summary: Mercurity Fintech Holding Inc. announced a $5.98 million asset purchase agreement with Huangtong International Co., Ltd. for Web3 decentralized storage infrastructure, including cryptocurrency mining servers. The payment will be made in the Company's ordinary shares. This strategic investment aims to solidify MFH's position as a leader in Web3 infrastructure and enhance current mining operations, adding a new revenue stream.

title: Goldman’s misadventures on Main Street
summary: Goldman Sachs is significantly scaling back its consumer banking ambitions, including winding down its personal-loan business, Marcus, and abandoning plans for checking accounts. This retreat comes amid pressure to improve profits, anticipated losses of billions for the consumer division, and upcoming layoffs and bonus cuts. The firm is shifting focus back to its traditional strengths in trading and investment banking.

title: Americans see big increases in holiday debt this season; average over $1,500
summary: A new LendingTree survey reveals that the average holiday debt for Americans increased to $1,549 this year, a 24% jump from last year and the highest in eight years. This surge is primarily attributed to inflation and higher interest rates, with many consumers taking five months or more to pay off their credit card debt. LendingTree's Chief Credit Analyst, Matt Schulz, advises using 0% balance transfer credit cards and negotiating lower interest rates with issuers to manage this debt effectively.

title: eToro launches ValueGurus, a first of its kind portfolio providing access to the ‘best buys’ according to leading value investors
summary: eToro has launched ValueGurus, a new Smart Portfolio designed to give retail investors exposure to the top 10 assets chosen by leading value-investing mutual and hedge funds. This portfolio is based on analysis of 13F filings, offering an alternative to social media investment advice by mirroring the strategies of real-world finance leaders. ValueGurus aims to help investors make more informed decisions and will be rebalanced quarterly.

title: Fintech RI Mau Go Public di AS, Ternyata Milik Eks Bos ISAT
summary: Indonesian fintech company DigiAsia, founded by former Indosat CEO Alexander Rusli, is reportedly going public in the United States on the Nasdaq exchange under the symbol FAAS. The company will merge with StoneBridge, a SPAC, to strengthen its presence in Southeast Asia, with a pre-money valuation of US$500 million. DigiAsia aims to become a leader in the white-label digital wallet and banking-as-a-service industry, with plans for expansion across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and North Africa.

title: BCI es la empresa con mejor reputación de Chile
summary: BCI has been recognized as the company with the best reputation in Chile for the eighth consecutive year, according to the Merco Chile 2022 ranking. Banco de Chile maintained its second position, while Mercado Libre rose to third place. Adicionalmente, Andrónico Luksic of Grupo Luksic was named the business leader with the best reputation for the fourth consecutive year.

title: American Express to Acquire Nipendo to Grow B2B Platform
summary: American Express has announced its plan to acquire Nipendo, a B2B payments automation company, to enhance its end-to-end B2B platform. The acquisition aims to streamline B2B payments, making transactions faster, more efficient, and transparent. This move aligns with a broader industry trend toward automation in invoicing and accounting functions, with other major payment companies also boosting their B2B offerings.

title: Bitcoin Could Be on Precipice of New Bull Market
summary: Bitcoin's strong start to 2023 has led some observers to believe it could be on the verge of a new bull market, potentially benefiting crypto-correlated ETFs like the Invesco Alerian Galaxy Blockchain Users and Decentralized Commerce ETF (BLKC). While historical patterns suggest a significant rally, future gains may not match the extreme percentages of previous cycles. BLKC also holds quality and value stocks, which could provide stability and support its performance.

title: D-Wave Highlights Commercial Customer Engagements, Cross-Platform Product Enhancements
summary: D-Wave announced new commercial customer engagements and product updates for its annealing and gate model quantum computing solutions at its Qubits 2023 user conference. The company highlighted real-world applications with customers like Mastercard and Davidson Technologies, demonstrating the growing commercial adoption of quantum-hybrid solutions. D-Wave also shared significant progress on its next-generation Advantage2™ annealing system and advancements in its gate model platform, emphasizing its commitment to delivering diverse quantum solutions.

title: UK travellers are the most idle across all Europe when it comes to working out on holiday, according to research by Marriott Bonvoy
summary: Research by Marriott Bonvoy reveals that UK travellers are the least active on holiday compared to other European, Middle Eastern, and South African vacationers, with nearly half avoiding exercise. While mental health is a key motivator for those who do work out, Marriott Bonvoy has partnered with FitnessOnDemand™ to offer virtual fitness classes to members, aiming to make it easier for travellers to maintain their routines and reduce feelings of guilt or unfitness. This partnership offers convenient access to various fitness options from hotel rooms, beaches, or gyms across over 450 participating hotels and resorts.

title: YPF acepta pagos con tarjeta de crédito
summary: YPF announced it will continue to accept credit card payments at its over 1,600 service stations across Argentina, with no issues reported for this payment method. The company ensures operators receive payment accreditation within 48 business hours for VISA and MasterCard transactions and benefits from a reduced transaction fee of 1.3%. This strategy aims to support station profitability and offer customers flexible payment options for fuel purchases.

title: Biometric payment cards launched by G+D, demoed by STMicroelectronics
summary: Giesecke+Devrient (G+D) has launched its second-generation biometric payment card, ‘Convego YOU,’ featuring technology from STMicroelectronics and Linxens. Simultaneously, STMicroelectronics is advancing its own biometric payment cards to market, demonstrating its STPay-Topaz-Bio biometric system-on-card, also incorporating Fingerprint Cards' sensors and Linxens' EMV module. Both companies aim to offer enhanced security and user experience in financial transactions through biometric authentication.

title: Mastercard Celebrates Pay by Bank And Its ‘Multi-Rail Strategy’ As It Records Its ’22 Results
summary: Mastercard reported its fourth-quarter and full-year 2022 results, highlighting its "multi-rail strategy" and new Pay by Bank program with JPMorgan Chase. While celebrating major deals, two significant news events—big banks creating a mobile wallet via Early Warning Services and an FTC consent order regarding online debit routing—were notably absent from their earnings call. The company announced $5.82 billion in quarterly revenue and discussed efforts in in-car payments alongside its traditional card and ACH services.

title: Consumers Shopping Smarter (Not Harder) Online
summary: Online shopping continues to gain market share from total retail sales, driven by consumers seeking discounts amid inflationary pressures. This trend was evident during the 2022 holiday season, with significant growth in online sales and increased adoption of omnichannel strategies like buy-online-pickup-in-store. Experts anticipate this shift towards smarter online shopping will persist as long as inflation remains a concern.

title: Salesforce Names Three Directors, Braces for Proxy Fight
summary: Salesforce Inc. has appointed three new independent directors to its board, including Mastercard CFO Sachin Mehra, ValueAct Capital CEO Mason Morfit, and former Carnival Corp. chief Arnold Donald. These appointments come as the business-software maker prepares for a potential proxy fight with activist investor Elliott Management Corp. The new directors are set to join the board on March 1.

title: Here's the real reason why American Express gives out such big rewards
summary: American Express generates its primary revenue from "discount revenue," which are fees charged to merchants. The company targets affluent, high-spending cardholders, focusing on a "spend-centric" model to drive spending. This model allows AmEx to offer substantial rewards, attracting customers willing to pay higher annual fees due to their spending habits.

title: AmEx shrugs off slowdown worries after forecasting upbeat full-year profit
summary: American Express (AmEx) defied economic slowdown concerns by forecasting an upbeat profit for the year, sending its shares up 10%. Despite high inflation, AmEx's affluent customer base has maintained spending momentum, with the company projecting 2023 net revenue growth between 15% and 17% and EPS of $11 to $11.40, exceeding analyst expectations. The company also reported a strong holiday quarter driven by increased customer spending, though it did set aside more funds for credit losses due to the gloomy economic outlook.

title: Salesforce appoints new board directors amid activist investor pressure
summary: Salesforce has appointed three new board directors, including hedge fund ValueAct Capital's chief, Mason Morfit, Mastercard CFO Sachin Mehra, and former Carnival Corp CEO Arnold Donald. This move comes amidst increasing pressure from activist investors seeking better cost control and management changes at the cloud-based software firm. While these appointments were planned to enhance operational skills, they also respond to demands from prominent activist investment firms like Elliott Management, Starboard Value, Inclusive Capital, and ValueAct, who have all engaged with Salesforce regarding their concerns.

title: PrescriberPoint Raises Significant Growth Investment from Lilly, Pfizer, Adobe, and Mastercard with a Mission to Reimagine the Traditional HCP-Pharmaceutical Company Engagement Model
summary: PrescriberPoint, a digital marketplace connecting healthcare providers with resources for patient therapy, has secured a significant Series Seed investment from Eli Lilly and Company, Pfizer Inc., Adobe Inc., and Mastercard Incorporated. This investment aims to reimagine the traditional HCP-pharmaceutical company engagement model by providing a "one-stop" digital ecosystem. The platform seeks to streamline prescribing workflows, address coverage and affordability challenges, and ultimately help patients access necessary medications more efficiently by reducing administrative burden on medical practices.

title: 10 Companies Who Inspire Creative Team Collaboration
summary: This article highlights ten companies that excel at fostering creative team collaboration. It explains how these businesses, ranging from tech giants like Google and Amazon to entertainment powerhouses like Disney and Blizzard Entertainment, prioritize open communication, diverse perspectives, and inclusive environments to drive innovation and achieve shared goals. The article emphasizes that creative collaboration is crucial for developing new ideas and products, leading to a sense of shared ownership and motivation among team members.

title: Jack Henry touts FedNow launch
summary: Jack Henry & Associates anticipates being the first payments processor to launch the Federal Reserve’s new real-time payment service, FedNow, in July. The company's president and chief operating officer, Greg Adelson, confirmed this during their fiscal second-quarter earnings call. Jack Henry expects 25 to 30 financial institutions, primarily community and regional banks and credit unions, to be part of its initial FedNow rollout.

title: PrescriberPoint Raises Significant Growth Investment from Lilly, Pfizer, Adobe, and Mastercard with a Mission to Reimagine the Traditional HCP-Pharmaceutical Company Engagement Model
summary: PrescriberPoint, a digital marketplace connecting healthcare providers with resources for patient therapy, announced a significant Series Seed investment from Eli Lilly and Company, Pfizer Inc., Adobe Inc., and Mastercard Incorporated. This investment aims to support PrescriberPoint's mission to transform the traditional HCP-pharmaceutical company engagement model into a "pull" rather than "push" system. The platform seeks to streamline prescribing workflows and reduce administrative burdens for healthcare providers by providing centralized access to product information, coverage, and affordability details for medications.

title: Choice Hotels, Wells Fargo, and Mastercard to Launch New Cobranded Credit Card
summary: Choice Hotels, Wells Fargo, and Mastercard have partnered to launch a new cobranded credit card program, the Choice Privileges Mastercard, which will offer enhanced rewards and benefits to members. The new card will provide accelerated point earnings on hotel stays and everyday purchases, automatic Gold Elite Membership, and various World Elite Mastercard benefits including cell phone protection and concierge services. Existing cardmembers will be converted to the new program in May 2023, with new applications also opening at that time.

title: Choice Hotels, Wells Fargo, and Mastercard to Launch New Cobranded Credit Card
summary: Choice Hotels, Wells Fargo, and Mastercard are partnering to launch a new cobranded credit card. The announcement was made via a press release from Wells Fargo's newsroom. This collaboration aims to offer benefits to customers of all three entities.

title: Is Payoneer Safe? Here's What You Need to Know
summary: Payoneer is a legitimate and widely available online payment service with a global reach. It is regulated by multiple governments and employs various security mechanisms like 2FA to protect user accounts and funds. While the service has faced minor controversies and user complaints regarding support, it maintains a strong security posture for a fintech company.

title: VIGI ETF Has A Quality Portfolio But We Prefer Other Alternatives (NASDAQ:VIGI)
summary: The Vanguard International Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIGI) focuses on large-cap international dividend growth stocks, excluding U.S. companies. While it holds a quality portfolio, its long-term growth potential may be inferior to U.S. peers and it carries more downside risk. The fund's price also shows an inverse correlation to the U.S. dollar index.

title: Six ways merchants can help prevent card testing attacks
summary: This article by Una Ryan Kearns of J.P. Morgan outlines six strategies for merchants to prevent card testing attacks, a growing threat driven by increased online transactions. These attacks, where fraudsters test stolen card credentials, can lead to significant costs through declined transactions and potential exposure to further fraud. The recommendations include enhanced monitoring, requiring more security elements, deploying velocity rules, using device fingerprinting, integrating security tools like Captcha, and implementing 3-D Secure protocols.

title: President Biden nominates General Atlantic's Ajay Banga to lead World Bank
summary: President Joe Biden nominated Ajay Banga, former Mastercard CEO and current General Atlantic Vice Chairman, to be the next president of the World Bank. The nomination follows current president David Malpass's decision to step down early. Biden highlighted Banga's upbringing in India and extensive business experience as key qualifications for leading the World Bank during a critical economic period.

title: 10 EMV facts every self-service machine operator should know
summary: This article provides 10 essential facts about EMV technology that self-service machine operators should know. It covers what EMV is, the differences between contact and contactless EMV, the future of magnetic stripe payments, and the importance of upgrading machines for EMV compliance to avoid losing revenue. The piece emphasizes that EMV contactless "tap" is sufficient for vending and highlights the necessity of upgrades, especially for those with 2G/3G telemeters.

title: Elliott nominates slate of directors to Salesforce board - source
summary: Activist investor Elliott Management Corp has nominated a slate of directors to the board of Salesforce Inc, following their multi-billion dollar stake acquisition in January. Elliott praised Salesforce's recent announcements, including accelerated margin targets and a $20 billion share repurchase, as steps toward regaining investor trust. This move adds pressure on Salesforce to deliver on promises and enhance accountability through board oversight.

title: Amex follows rivals in ditching gun code
summary: American Express and Discover Financial Services have followed Visa and Mastercard in pausing the implementation of a new merchant category code for gun and ammunition stores. This decision comes amidst legal uncertainty and potential legislation in several U.S. states aiming to restrict or prohibit the use of the code. The controversial code, approved by ISO in September 2022, was intended by gun control advocates to track suspicious purchases but has been criticized by Republicans as a threat to consumer privacy and gun rights.

title: Bancolombia baja las tasas de interés de sus tarjetas de crédito
summary: Bancolombia announced a reduction in interest rates for credit card purchases from 46% to 25% effective annual, starting March 10. This measure will benefit 1.3 million cardholders with limits up to 3.9 million pesos, representing 50% of Bancolombia's credit cards. The bank stated this decision was made in response to high inflation and interest rates, aiming to support the financial well-being of Colombians.

title: GICS changes set to impact S&P 500 and sector ETFs
summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices and MSCI are implementing changes to the Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) in March 2023, which will significantly impact S&P 500 and sector-specific ETFs. Key reclassifications include moving payment processing companies like Visa and Mastercard from IT to financials, and certain data processing services to industrials, while also adjusting retailer classifications based on goods sold. These changes are expected to alter sector weights, particularly in information technology, financials, and industrials, leading to rebalancing in related ETFs.

title: Credit Card Giants Back Away From Tracking Gun Purchases
summary: Major credit card companies including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover have announced a pause in their plans to implement a new merchant category code (MCC) specifically for tracking gun and ammunition purchases. This decision comes in response to significant pushback from state attorneys general and the introduction of legislation in several states aimed at preventing such tracking. While gun rights advocates view this as a partial victory, the National Shooting Sports Foundation cautions that it is only a pause and not an abandonment of the divisive MCC.

title: Los avisos de consumo que implementó el BBVA en la app (incluye débito)
summary: BBVA has implemented an immediate consumption alert system in its banking app, including for debit card transactions, which was not previously available through traditional card services like Visa Home or MasterConsultas. This new feature provides real-time notifications for purchases, improving security and enabling better tracking of expenses, especially for travelers. The author discusses the system's effectiveness, contrasting it with the outdated notifications from card networks, and hopes other banks will adopt similar immediate alert systems.

title: Mastercard (NYSE:MA) - Stock Analysis
summary: This Simply Wall St analysis of Mastercard (NYSE:MA) evaluates its stock based on valuation, future growth, past performance, financial health, and dividends. The company is trading below its estimated fair value, with analysts predicting future growth in earnings and stock price. The report also highlights Mastercard's strong financial health, market dominance in digital payments, and recent corporate updates including dividends and acquisitions.

title: Apple introduces Apple Pay Later to allow consumers to pay for purchases over time
summary: Apple has introduced Apple Pay Later in the U.S., allowing users to split purchases between $50 and $1,000 into four payments over six weeks with no interest or fees. Designed with financial health in mind, the service integrates into Apple Wallet for easy tracking and management of loans, with repayment via linked debit cards. Apple Financing LLC, a subsidiary of Apple Inc., is responsible for credit assessment and lending, and will report loans to U.S. credit bureaus starting in the fall, while Mastercard and Goldman Sachs facilitate the program.

title: Apple Introduces Buy Now, Pay Later Service. Here's How It Will Work.
summary: Apple is launching a "buy now, pay later" service, integrated with Apple Pay and Mastercard, which will require debit card and bank account payments rather than credit cards, and will not charge late fees. The loans will be interest-free, but missed payments could lead to loss of access to the service and be reported to credit bureaus. This service aims to provide a flexible payment option, especially for consumers seeking alternatives to traditional credit, though experts advise caution regarding potential debt accumulation and lack of consumer protections compared to credit cards.

title: State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLF) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLF), including its current stock price, key statistics, top holdings, and dividend information. As of November 27, 2025, XLF holds 75 stocks with a total value of $53.95 billion, with top holdings like Berkshire Hathaway Inc and JPMorgan Chase & Co. The ETF's PE Ratio is 17.01 and its dividend yield is 1.32%.

title: Direxion Daily Financial Bull 3x Shares (FAS) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a comprehensive overview of Direxion Daily Financial Bull 3x Shares (FAS), including its current stock price, holdings, and dividend yield. It details the ETF's portfolio as of July 31, 2025, highlighting top holdings like Berkshire Hathaway and JPMorgan Chase, and offers historical performance data and key fundamental statistics. The report also lists recent trades and top stock picks for FAS.

title: Herner named ACC-St. Louis Chapter president
summary: The Association of Corporate Counsel-St. Louis Chapter has elected Jennifer Herner, associate general counsel for Anheuser-Busch, as its new president. She succeeds Kate Krebel, with other elected officers including Beverly Garner as president-elect, Danielle Langeneckert as treasurer, and Anthony “Jay” Repaso as secretary. The article also lists the members of the 2023 board of directors and their respective roles within the chapter.

title: 13 Top Earth Day Campaigns This Decade
summary: This article showcases 13 impactful Earth Day campaigns from the past decade that successfully blend brand messaging with environmental awareness. It highlights how companies like Lundberg Family Farms, Sony BBC Earth, Impossible Foods, and Mastercard have utilized creative strategies, from catchy slogans and video content to gamified sustainability and strategic partnerships, to engage consumers and promote eco-friendly initiatives. The piece emphasizes that sustainability is not only good for the planet but also a powerful tool for business, resonating with a growing number of environmentally conscious consumers.

title: Cashless drives small transaction sales in vending, amusements
summary: A report by Cantaloupe Inc. indicates that cashless payments are increasingly common for small transactions (under $10) in vending and amusement machines across the U.S. and Canada. The study found that cashless transactions accounted for a significant majority of sales and led to higher average spending compared to cash purchases. Furthermore, the self-service retail industry demonstrated resilience against inflation and saw a substantial increase in EMV payment adoption.

title: Expedia will revamp booking for Travel Agent Affiliate Program
summary: Expedia plans to revamp the booking experience for its Travel Agent Affiliate Program (TAAP) this year, with testing expected to begin this quarter. The program, which serves over 35,000 travel agencies in more than 30 countries, will incorporate further AI and machine learning technologies already used in Expedia's B2C channels, and is exploring the integration of generative AI like ChatGPT. This move underscores Expedia's increasing investment in its B2B segment, which saw a 55% revenue growth in the first quarter.

title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Visa, Mastercard, Fiserv, FLEETCOR Technologies and WEX
summary: This article discusses the Zacks Financial Transaction Services industry outlook, highlighting five key companies: Visa, Mastercard, Fiserv, FLEETCOR Technologies, and WEX. The industry is poised for growth due to increasing digitization, strategic M&A activities, favorable consumer spending, and rebounding cross-border travel. The article details the financial performance and future prospects of each highlighted company.

title: Citizens makes wealth-management push with private-client card
summary: Citizens Bank has introduced a new private-client credit card featuring Mastercard's tactile "Touch Card" technology, designed to assist visually impaired consumers. This launch is part of Citizens' broader strategy to expand its wealth-management offerings and attract high-net-worth clients, as its mass-market customer base has been declining. The card also offers benefits such as a yearly rebate, 2% cash back, and airport lounge access, aiming to provide a high-service banking experience combined with tailored financial planning.

title: Google Pay
summary: This article from Barclays Private Bank details how to use Google Pay with Barclays debit cards, highlighting its security, convenience, and functionality for in-store and online payments. It provides step-by-step instructions for adding cards, answers frequently asked questions about eligibility, device compatibility, transaction limits, and what to do if a device is lost or stolen. Contact information for various client types is also included for support.

title: Generative AI is too much for Amex to ignore
summary: American Express is strategically incorporating generative AI to enhance customer experience, analyzing customer sentiments and predicting finances, without developing its own large language model. This move aligns with a broader industry trend where executives anticipate high impact from generative AI within three to five years, though mass implementation is still in early stages due to concerns about data privacy and regulation. The payments industry expects generative AI to reimagine various verticals, highlighting the need for regulatory frameworks to protect data and ensure financial stability.

title: Fidelity Disruptive Finance ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (FDFF) $FDFF
summary: The Fidelity Disruptive Finance ETF (FDFF) has an aggregate "Moderate Buy" rating, calculated from 297 analyst ratings on 17 of its constituent companies, which represent 55% of the portfolio. The aggregate price target for FDFF is $32.77, covering the same 17 companies. The report details the top holdings, their weight in the ETF, individual consensus ratings, price targets, and potential upside.

title: Fidelity Crypto Industry and Digital Payments ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (FDIG)
summary: MarketBeat provides an aggregate rating and price target for the Fidelity Crypto Industry and Digital Payments ETF (FDIG) by analyzing analyst ratings for its underlying holdings. As of March 4, 2026, FDIG holds a "Moderate Buy" aggregate rating based on 423 analyst ratings covering 22 companies, with an aggregate price target indicating a slight downside from its current price. The article details top holdings and their individual analyst consensus ratings and price targets.

title: D-Wave Quantum Regains NYSE Compliance, Continues Trading Amid Quantum Computing Advancements
summary: D-Wave Quantum Inc. has announced its regained compliance with the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) listing standards after its share price surpassed the $1.00 minimum requirement on June 30, 2023, and maintained an average closing price above this threshold for 30 trading days. As the world's first commercial supplier of quantum computers, the company will continue to trade on the NYSE. D-Wave provides quantum computing systems, software, and services to major organizations globally, specializing in both annealing and gate-model quantum computers.

title: You'll soon be able to earn Air Miles at Dollarama
summary: Canadians will soon be able to earn Air Miles at Dollarama stores nationwide, starting August 7th. Shoppers with a linked Canadian-issued Mastercard can earn 10 Bonus Miles on purchases of $30 or more until November 6, 2023. BMO Air Miles credit card holders will also receive five times the points on Dollarama purchases during the same period, following BMO's acquisition of the Air Miles program.

title: With 73% ownership, Xylem Inc. (NYSE:XYL) boasts of strong institutional backing
summary: Xylem Inc. (NYSE:XYL) shows strong institutional backing with 73% ownership, indicating significant influence from large investors. BlackRock, Inc., The Vanguard Group, Inc., and Aristotle Capital Management, LLC are among the largest shareholders. While insiders own less than 1% of the company, the general public holds a 27% stake.

title: Visa, Mastercard Hit With Antitrust Suit Over Credit Card Fees
summary: Visa Inc. and Mastercard Inc. are facing a new antitrust lawsuit filed by Block Inc., formerly Square Inc. The suit alleges that the credit card companies conspired to overcharge Square's payment platform with inflated "interchange" fees, which Block claims led to higher retail prices for consumers. The lawsuit was filed on July 14 in the US District Court for the Eastern District of New York.

title: Amex pays $15M OCC penalty
summary: American Express has agreed to pay a $15 million civil monetary penalty to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for failing to properly monitor a third-party affiliate and for misconduct related to retaining small business clients between 2015 and 2017. The OCC cited Amex for violating customer identification program regulations and engaging in unsafe or unsound practices. Amex stated that the issues have been addressed by updating sales policies, enhancing training, and providing customer remediation.

title: White Castle to roll out voice AI to over 100 drive-thrus
summary: White Castle is partnering with SoundHound to implement voice AI in over 100 drive-thrus by the end of 2024, continuing its early adoption of restaurant automation. This technology aims to automate order taking, process orders within 60 seconds with a 90% completion rate, and potentially boost revenue through consistent upsells. This move follows an earlier trial in 2020 and places White Castle among other QSRs testing drive-thru AI solutions to enhance efficiency and address labor savings.

title: Expedia Group sees cause for optimism in record Q2 earnings
summary: Expedia Group reported record Q2 lodging gross bookings of $19.2 billion and revenue of $3.4 billion, a 7% and 6% increase year-over-year respectively. Despite these records, Wall Street reacted negatively due to slower growth than analysts expected, causing stock to dip. CEO Peter Kern remains optimistic, highlighting the launch of the unified One Key rewards program, strong B2B partnerships with companies like Walmart and Mastercard, and the adoption of AI technologies like ChatGPT.

title: ¿Eres cliente de Banco de Chile? Conoce cómo añadir tus tarjetas a Apple Pay
summary: This article explains how Banco de Chile customers can add their credit and debit cards to Apple Pay, which recently launched in Chile. It details the steps for setting up cards via the Apple Wallet app or directly through the Banco de Chile's Mi Banco app, highlighting the security and convenience of using Apple Pay for transactions both domestically and internationally.

title: Jack Henry & Associates trims workforce
summary: Jack Henry & Associates has offered a voluntary early retirement program to some employees, expecting 160 exits at a cost of about $17.5 million. This move is anticipated to provide net savings and streamline the workforce, following economic concerns and bank failures. The company also reported record net income and revenue for the fiscal fourth quarter despite a decline in overall client count.

title: D-Wave Achieves Breakthrough in Quantum Computing with State-of-the-Art Fluxonium Qubits
summary: D-Wave has announced a significant breakthrough in quantum computing with the successful development and testing of state-of-the-art fluxonium qubits. These qubits demonstrate coherence properties and effective temperatures comparable to the best reported in scientific literature, making them a viable candidate for next-generation gate model quantum computing architectures. This development is expected to significantly impact D-Wave's hardware development, addressing some known shortcomings of competing superconducting qubits.

title: How employers can tap into their workforce's hidden skill set
summary: Many companies are overlooking a "goldmine of untapped talent" within their current workforce, according to CHROs. This article discusses how technology, such as AI, can help identify and leverage employees' latent skills. It also highlights the cultural shift required to enable more flexible team structures and internal career mobility.

title: Amex pilots biometrics in online checkout
summary: American Express is piloting facial and fingerprint recognition for its SafeKey fraud prevention service in online checkout. The company is testing these biometric capabilities with a fraction of its U.S. consumer cardholders before a broader rollout early next year, aiming to mitigate fraud and simplify the online shopping experience. This move comes as consumers seek faster and more secure authentication methods beyond traditional passwords and PINs.

title: Mastercard® Announces New Partnerships with Instacart and Peacock to Provide Greater Everyday Value and Convenience Where it Matters Most to Consumers
summary: Mastercard has announced new partnerships with Instacart and Peacock to enhance its consumer rewards credit card offerings. These collaborations provide cardholders with valuable benefits, including Instacart+ membership perks and statement credits for Peacock Premium streaming services, directly addressing everyday spending categories like groceries and digital entertainment. The initiative aims to deliver meaningful value and convenience to cardholders amidst rising costs, complementing Mastercard's existing suite of benefits.

title: Fed expected to lower bank debit card fees. Wait! But Visa/Mastercard want to raise credit card fees again!
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is expected to propose a rule that would lower the cap on debit card swipe fees, a move criticized by banks but supported by retailers and consumer advocates. Meanwhile, Visa and Mastercard are anticipated to increase credit card swipe fees, leading consumer groups and a bipartisan coalition in Congress to push for the Credit Card Competition Act to introduce competition and regulate these fees, which they argue disproportionately affect consumers. The article highlights the ongoing "holy war" between banks and retailers over these interchange fees.

title: Mastercard Partners With Live Nation to Offer Exclusive Live Music Benefits and Experiences for Cardholders Around the World
summary: Mastercard has announced a multi-year partnership with Live Nation to provide exclusive live music benefits and experiences to millions of cardholders in 19 markets across Europe and Asia through priceless.com. These benefits include presale tickets, premium seats, and VIP experiences. The partnership also supports the Priceless Planet Coalition, allowing cardholders to contribute to tree restoration efforts when purchasing concert tickets during specific presale events.

title: Jack Henry lands more FedNow clients
summary: Jack Henry & Associates has connected 40 customers to the FedNow instant payments system, with 150 more in the implementation queue, though all current live customers are in receive-only mode. The company expects to have approximately 150 live customers by early 2024 and anticipates more will add send capabilities. While FedNow adoption has been slow overall, Jack Henry also noted a significant increase in RTP network transactions, primarily from digital wallets and other specific payment types.

title: Circle K taps Nayax for cashless payments at EV charging stations
summary: Circle K has partnered with Nayax to implement cashless payment solutions at its EV charging stations. This collaboration allows EV drivers to use various cashless and contactless payment methods, similar to those used at traditional gas stations. Nuvei processes these transactions via Nayax's unattended payment terminals to enhance user experience and payment acceptance.

title: Polish Mobile Payment System BLIK to Modernize and Expand into Romania and Slovakia with DXC Technology
summary: DXC Technology will support Polish Payment Standard (PSP) in expanding its mobile payment system, BLIK, into Romania and Slovakia. DXC will modernize BLIK's central system to handle transactions in Romanian Leu and Euros, connect to SWIFT, and adapt the system for the fastest-growing e-commerce segments in these new markets. This initiative builds on a nine-year relationship and aims to achieve international success for BLIK.

title: The Walt Disney Company Board Appoints Morgan Stanley's James P. Gorman and Veteran Media Executive Sir Jeremy Darroch as New Directors
summary: The Walt Disney Company has appointed James P. Gorman, Chairman and CEO of Morgan Stanley, and Sir Jeremy Darroch, former Group Chief Executive of Sky, to its Board of Directors. These appointments, effective January and February 2024 respectively, follow a comprehensive search and aim to strengthen the board with leaders experienced in financial institutions and international media. Concurrently, board member Francis A. deSouza will not seek re-election to pursue new opportunities in the technology sector.

title: Millions of U.S. Businesses Eligible for a Share of $5.54B Payment Card Settlement
summary: The claim submission process has begun for the largest private antitrust class-action settlement in U.S. history, a $5.54 billion payment card settlement. Millions of U.S. businesses that accepted Visa and/or Mastercard credit or debit cards between January 1, 2004, and January 25, 2019, are eligible to file claims. Claim forms are being mailed throughout December, and businesses can find more information and file claims online at www.PaymentCardSettlement.com.

title: 7 Stocks That Your Grandchildren Will Be Glad You Bought for Them
summary: This article suggests seven high-quality stocks to buy and hold for grandchildren as a long-term investment and a way to teach them about personal finance. The selected stocks, including Automatic Data Processing, Broadcom, Alphabet, and UnitedHealth Group, are chosen for their strong earnings, dividend growth, and potential for market-beating returns over several decades. The author emphasizes that these gifts could lead to substantial wealth and financial success for future generations.

title: Software Firm Endava Signs on for an Integration With the Upcoming Paze Wallet
summary: Endava plc, a software-development firm, has announced an integration with Paze, the upcoming digital wallet backed by major banks, which will enable merchants using Endava's services to offer Paze's online checkout when it launches in 2024. Paze aims to simplify online checkouts for 150 million payment cards by leveraging existing cardholder relationships with issuing banks, eliminating the need for manual card entry and enhancing security. This move supports the accelerated-checkout trend in e-commerce, offering features like multiple shipping addresses and a card updater.

title: AngloGold Ashanti, Absa Bank and MasterCard Foundation unveil new initiative
summary: AngloGold Ashanti (Ghana) Limited-Obuasi Mine, Absa Bank Ghana Limited, and MasterCard Foundation have partnered to launch a new initiative aimed at fostering business growth and sustainability for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Obuasi. This collaboration includes four key projects: a Business Acceleration and Sustainability Project (BAST), Women in e-commerce project, Business Supply Chain Development Project, and Artisans to Entrepreneurs project. The BAST project, aligned with AngloGold Ashanti's 10-Year Socio-Economic Development Plan, seeks to enhance business sustainability, provide entrepreneurial skills, and increase access to finance and markets, thereby fostering job creation.

title: With 61% ownership of the shares, Amcor plc (NYSE:AMCR) is heavily dominated by institutional owners
summary: Institutional investors hold a dominant 61% ownership in Amcor plc (NYSE:AMCR), indicating their strong influence on the company's stock performance. While BlackRock, The Vanguard Group, and State Street Global Advisors are among the largest shareholders, no single entity controls a majority, suggesting a widely disseminated ownership structure. The article also touches upon the general public's 38% ownership and the minimal insider holdings, emphasizing the importance of institutional analysis for future performance assessment.

title: Bet on BLKC for Exposure to Some of the Best Financial Stocks
summary: The Invesco Alerian Galaxy Blockchain Users and Decentralized Commerce ETF (BLKC) was a top-performing thematic ETF in 2023, driven by rallying cryptocurrency and large-cap tech stocks. While these factors could continue to influence BLKC in 2024, the ETF's significant allocation to financial services stocks, including traditional banks like JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America, and credit services providers like Mastercard and Visa, presents an additional strong point for potential growth this year, even with sector reclassifications.

title: Bet on BLKC for Exposure to Some of the Best Financial Stocks
summary: The Invesco Alerian Galaxy Blockchain Users and Decentralized Commerce ETF (BLKC) performed exceptionally well in 2023, largely due to rising cryptocurrency prices and large-cap technology stocks. While those factors may continue, the article highlights BLKC's significant allocation to financial services stocks, including traditional banks like JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America, as well as growth-oriented credit services providers like Mastercard and Visa. These financial holdings are expected to contribute significantly to the ETF's potential upside in 2024.

title: The Federal Reserve’s Balancing Act Between Inflation and Growth
summary: This article discusses the Federal Reserve's challenge of achieving a "soft landing" – curbing inflation without causing a recession – and analyzes economic indicators for 2024. It highlights the continued strength of the U.S. economy, exemplified by GDP growth and strong retail sales, and examines gold's prospects in such a scenario, noting that geopolitical tensions and central bank buying could support its price despite historical trends.

title: EPC Highlights Credit Unions, Community Banks' Opposition to Durbin-Marshall Credit Card Bill
summary: The Electronic Payments Coalition (EPC) has launched a new campaign highlighting the widespread opposition of credit unions and community banks to the Durbin-Marshall Credit Card Bill. Financial institutions and their representative organizations argue that the proposed legislation would negatively impact consumers, small businesses, and community financial institutions by reducing credit access, weakening cybersecurity, and eliminating rewards programs, while primarily benefiting large retailers. The coalition, representing nearly 10,000 financial institutions and over 140 million Americans, asserts that the bill's "carve-out" for smaller institutions is ineffective and would impose significant systemic costs.

title: Remitly taps ads to woo new clients
summary: Remitly, a cross-border payments company, significantly increased its advertising budget last year to build its brand and attract new customers, according to CEO Matt Oppenheimer. The company focuses on "performance marketing" through online and social media ads, alongside broader brand awareness campaigns in locations like airports. Despite a 24% rise in marketing expenses, Remitly achieved a 47% increase in revenue for the first nine months of the previous year, although it continues to operate at a loss.

title: Visa, Mastercard ask US Supreme Court to undo class-action orders
summary: Visa and Mastercard have petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to reverse a judge's order that allowed consumers and ATM operators to pursue class-action lawsuits seeking billions in damages over transaction fees. The payment giants argue that the lower court's approval of fragmented classes without rigorous analysis contributes to legal confusion. This case has been ongoing since 2011, with the class actions seeking over $9 billion.

title: CEO Spotlight - Peter Kern of Expedia Group
summary: Peter Kern, CEO of Expedia Group, reflects on his four years leading the company, detailing its significant progress in simplifying operations, reorganizing technology with a single platform migration, and launching the One Key loyalty program. He discusses the company's early adoption of generative AI and expansion of its B2B strategy, including cutting ties with Hopper for marketplace integrity. Kern also shares insights into attracting younger travelers and Expedia's strategy for global growth.

title: Visa, Mastercard ask U.S. Supreme Court to fix ‘rampant confusion’ on class certification
summary: Visa and Mastercard have petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to clarify the standard for class certification, arguing there is "rampant confusion" among lower courts regarding the "rigorous analysis" required to determine if classwide issues predominate over individual ones. This request comes as they face $9 billion in potential exposure from three antitrust class actions related to ATM fees. The companies contend that circuits are divided on how to weigh defendants' challenges to plaintiffs' classwide injury models, necessitating Supreme Court intervention.

title: Fleet fintech ditches Visa for Mastercard
summary: Fuel card startup AtoB has switched its exclusive commercial credit card tie from Visa to Mastercard, aiming to better compete with industry leaders Wex and Fleetcor. CEO Vignan Velivela stated that Mastercard's network is superior for the trucking industry, highlighting its longer history in fleet payments and advanced routing technology for fuel optimization. AtoB, backed by $112 million in funding, plans to offer real-time payments, cybersecurity, perks, and discounts to trucking companies of all sizes.

title: American Express, Visa, Mastercard move ahead with code to track gun store purchases in California
summary: Major credit card companies, including American Express, Visa, and Mastercard, are implementing a new merchant code for firearm and ammunition retailers in California to comply with a new state law. This code, intended to identify suspicious purchasing patterns and help prevent gun crime, has faced pushback from Second Amendment advocates and conflicting legislation in other states. Despite the national controversy, these companies have assured congressional Democrats they will meet California's May 2025 deadline for its adoption.

title: Consumer Advances Info-Broker Suit Against Mastercard’s Finicity
summary: A federal court ruled that Mastercard-owned Finicity Corp. must face a proposed class action lawsuit. The suit alleges Finicity deceptively collected and sold financial data from smartphone personal-finance app users without their knowledge or consent. The court rejected Finicity's motion to compel arbitration and found the plaintiff had sufficient standing for her claims.

title: Capital One May Acquire Discover. What Could That Mean?
summary: Reports suggest Capital One Financial Corp. may acquire Discover Financial Services, a deal that would significantly impact the U.S. payments industry by combining two major credit card issuers. This acquisition would grant Capital One access to Discover's processing network, including the Pulse and Discover Global Networks, potentially transforming its role in the market and having implications for pending legislation like the Credit Card Competition Act. Analysts highlight the potential for Capital One to achieve a dominant position in the U.S. credit card market and leverage Discover's extensive network.

title: Capital One to acquire Discover Financial
summary: Capital One announced its plan to acquire Discover Financial Services in an all-stock transaction valued at a 26.6% premium. The deal, expected to close in late 2024 or early 2025, aims to create a global payments platform with significant synergies. The acquisition will leverage Capital One's technology transformation and expand its presence in the financial services sector, while maintaining the Discover brand on its cards.

title: Why Many Retailers in Maine Don’t Accept American Express Cards
summary: Many retailers in Maine, including some large stores like Costco, do not accept American Express cards due to the higher transaction fees charged by American Express compared to Visa and Mastercard. This issue particularly affects small "mom and pop" businesses with tighter margins, where the higher fees can significantly impact profitability. Consequently, consumers should be mindful of which credit cards they carry when shopping at various establishments in Maine.

title: Capital One To Acquire Discover Financial For $35.3 Billion
summary: Capital One announced an agreement to acquire Discover Financial for $35.3 billion in an all-stock deal. This merger aims to create a payments giant serving over 100 million customers, with potential pre-tax synergies of $2.7 billion. The acquisition, pending regulatory and shareholder approval, is expected to close in late 2024 or early 2025.

title: Capital One Archives
summary: This article compiles various news updates related to Capital One, highlighting its activities in fintech, partnerships, and product innovations. Key events include Capital One's planned acquisition of Discover, collaborations with fraud prevention specialists like Signifyd, participation in the FedNow Instant Payments Pilot Program, and advancements in mobile banking and payment services. The article showcases Capital One's continuous efforts in digital transformation and strategic growth within the financial industry.

title: Capital One buys Discover Financial Services in a $35.3 billion deal, combining 2 of US's largest credit card companies
summary: Capital One is acquiring Discover Financial Services for $35.3 billion in an all-stock deal, merging two of the largest credit card companies in the U.S. This acquisition aims to enhance Capital One's position in the competitive credit card market and build a payments network that can compete with major players. Discover shareholders will receive a 27% premium, and the deal is expected to close in late 2024 or early 2025, pending regulatory approval.

title: For Cap One, the Pulse Network Is the ‘Rare Asset’ in Its $35.3 Billion Deal for Discover
summary: Capital One's $35.3 billion acquisition of Discover Financial Services is primarily driven by Discover's Pulse debit network, which CEO Richard Fairbank considers a "rare asset." Moving Capital One's debit business to Pulse and parts of its credit card business to Discover's network aims to significantly boost Discover's scale and propel Capital One into the global payment-network space, mimicking the integrated issuer and network model of American Express. This strategy also provides a pricing advantage, as Discover's model is exempt from certain Durbin Amendment rules affecting debit interchange.

title: Capital One to acquire Discover in $35.3B deal
summary: Capital One is set to acquire Discover in a $35.3 billion all-stock deal, aiming to significantly boost its credit card presence and create a combined entity with a 19% share of the revolving consumer loan market. The acquisition is expected to stabilize Discover after a challenging 2023 and reduce Capital One's reliance on Visa and Mastercard. However, the deal faces potential scrutiny from regulators concerned about market competition and benefits to the public.

title: Capital One to acquire Discover for $35bn; top US banks face surge in bad property debt
summary: Capital One is set to acquire Discover Financial Services in a $35.3bn all-stock deal, aiming to create the sixth-largest US bank by assets and a major credit card competitor. This merger is expected to face intense antitrust scrutiny, particularly given planned reforms to US bank merger regulations. Concurrently, US banks are grappling with a surge in problematic commercial property debt.

title: Discover Financial rises on Capital One's $35 billion deal, payment processors fall
summary: Capital One Financial's $35.3 billion all-stock deal for Discover Financial is expected to create the largest U.S. credit card issuer and introduce new competition to payment giants Visa and Mastercard. While Discover's shares rose, Visa and Mastercard saw declines due to the potential shift of Capital One's card portfolio to Discover's network. The deal faces regulatory scrutiny, with varying opinions on its impact on competition and financial stability.

title: Capital One's $35 billion Discover deal hinges on playing consumer champion
summary: Capital One's proposed $35.3 billion acquisition of Discover Financial faces regulatory hurdles, with experts suggesting approval depends on Capital One demonstrating how the deal will benefit consumers. Investors assign only a 50% chance to the deal's completion due to concerns about high credit card interest rates and fees.
